jobs.title: Product Expert - Clinical Operations
jobs.excerpt: Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster.
jobs.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Veeva is looking for a highly motivated individual with life science industry experience within the Clinical Operations (Clinical Trials) domain to drive customer success with our Veeva Clinical Operations products family in Europe.
As part of the European and broader Global Product Expert teams, your experience will play a key role in the Product organization. You will:
  1. Build and foster highly engaged Users Communities; regularly communicating with them in a range of forums to provide clear and impactful communication that drives shared understanding & education, promotes product adoption, and delivers customer value
  2. Represent the Product organization in customer meetings, online communities, with internal team education and at industry events – driving increased customer value through release education and product capability promotion
  3. As a Voice for the Customers, capture and relay their needs (and industry-specific learnings) to our Product Management team based across the US, helping them to inform product decisions and improve designs that ultimately create better Clinical Operations products that enable:
    • AI & Digital transformation
    • Risk-based decision making
    • Regulatory compliance
    • A culture of continuous improvement
    • Operational excellence across the pharmaceutical industry
  4. Develop rich relationships with key product users / influencers
  5. Collaborate effectively with Veeva field teams to drive customer success, product excellence, best practices (Good Vault Practice) and Veeva success!
This role is ideal for someone passionate about Clinical Operations and associated processes, eager to collaborate with customers, and excited to drive their success.

What You'll Do

  • Be the product evangelist and provide subject matter expertise for the Veeva Clinical Operations products
  • Act as a champion for Veeva's key product enhancements (for example, learning the overarching Veeva AI vision to effectively guide customers through their AI transformation journeys together with Veeva colleagues). Stay up to date with the latest features, strategy and roadmap
  • Contribute to best practices and process recommendations within the Veeva Clinical Operations product area
  • Engage with customer stakeholders to communicate product roadmap and vision
  • Provide product education to Veeva Clinical Operations customers in meetings (in a range of forums) and our online communities (Veeva Connect); Ensuring we are communicating the problems we are solving, value delivered and product functionality
  • Be the customer advocate internally. Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer feedback. Feed these insights into release planning, contributing to future product innovations
  • Collaborate with Product teams to deliver valuable content and resources for product and release communication
  • Provide cross-functional product expertise to internal teams, including Services, Strategy, Sales, and Product Support

Requirements

  • 5+ years working in the Clinical Operations (Clinical Trials) space, usually in Product Management, Consulting or Professional Services/Implementation roles and with hands-on experience of associated software tools (e.g. CTMS, eTMF or Study Start-up) and associated operational processes
  • 3+ years experience with Veeva Clinical Operations applications (TMF, CTMS, SSU, Site Connect) is highly recommended
  • Ability to understand customer business requirements and to translate them to technical product requirements, preferences, and limitations – communicated to both business and technical stakeholders
  • Ability to understand Product Vision, Technical Specifications and Software Development Documentation, and translate them into language and content relevant for end users and business teams
  • Experience in interacting with customers from business users, IT departments, and executive suite, as well as internal teams, both in-person and remote (including software demonstrations and presentations)
  • Strong analytical skills and English skills (written, verbal, and formal presentations)
  • A strong passion for emerging technologies (specifically AI) and the ability to quickly grasp, articulate, and conceptualize how AI-driven features solve real-world clinical operations problems (including some exposure to AI in driving efficiencies in your existing role and/ or optimizing workflows)
  • Self-directed team player with a positive attitude
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%
  • Based in Europe (with ability to work across time-zones)

Nice to Have

  • Veeva Clinical Operations Products experience
  • Fluency in another European language
  • Creating engaging videos with familiarity with Video Recording software (e.g. Camtasia)
  • Experience with Risk Management in the Life Sciences domain

    • Note: Veeva will consider applicants from European countries where Veeva has representatives.

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Compensation

  • Total compensation: 80,000 - 160,000 EUR
  • The total compensation range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential total compensation range for this role. Please note that actual total compensation may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position's total compensation may be composed of other types of compensation, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

jobs.title: Air Traffic Training SME (Part-Time / On-Call)
jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesJoin Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA’s Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) contract. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, Peraton helps deliver the systems and services that keep our nation’s skies safe and connected. We’re looking for innovative professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are passionate about shaping the future of air traffic management. This is your chance to make an impact on one of the world’s most vital transportation infrastructures, working alongside leaders in aviation, engineering, data science, and systems integration.

At Peraton, you won’t just support the mission — you’ll define it.

Do you want to play a critical role in shaping the future of America’s skies? As the Air Traffic Training SME you’ll design, deliver, and oversee innovative training programs that keep our National Airspace System (NAS) safe, efficient, and ready for the challenges of tomorrow. This is more than just a training role—it’s a leadership opportunity to influence how the next generation of air traffic professionals are prepared. You’ll bring together your expertise in instructional design, FAA air traffic control procedures, and large-scale training program management to ensure personnel perform at their highest level. This role is ideal for a training professional ready to step into leadership, expand their influence, and contribute to one of the most mission-critical systems in the country.

Work Location:

  • This is an Part-Time / On-Call role.
  • Remote work is permitted; candidates must reside within the contiguous United States.
  • Must be able to travel 50% of the time to support deployments at CONUS and potentially OCONUS locations.

In this position, you will:

  • Develop, deliver, and evaluate comprehensive air traffic and technical training programs supporting NAS modernization.
  • Translate complex FAA operational procedures, system requirements, and technical information into clear, engaging training.
  • Develop or maintain instructor-led training, virtual learning, simulations, exercises, job aids, and performance-based assessments.
  • Deliver classroom, virtual, and hands-on instruction to operational and technical personnel.
  • Partner with FAA SMEs, engineers, system integrators, instructors, and program teams to ensure training accurately reflects system functionality and operational procedures.
  • Maintain training materials, curricula, schedules, qualification records, and other required training documentation.
  • Provide subject matter expertise regarding FAA air traffic operations, procedures, and NAS environments.
  • Identify training risks, gaps, and readiness concerns and work with program leadership to develop mitigation strategies.
  • Maintain accurate training records and drive continuous program improvements.

Why This Role Matters

Every flight depends on well-prepared air traffic professionals. By leading training programs at this scale, you’ll directly impact national aviation safety and efficiency while shaping the careers of those who manage our skies. As an Air Traffic Training SME, you'll help bridge the gap between new technology and operational readiness, ensuring personnel have the knowledge and practical skills needed to support the continued safety, efficiency, and reliability of America's airspace.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • U.S. Citizenship Required.
  • Must have the ability to obtain / maintain a Public Trust clearance.
  • Bachelors degree and 12 years’ relevant experience or Masters degree with 10 years experience or Associates degree with 14 years of experience or HS diploma with 16 years experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in air traffic training, instructional design, technical training, training development, and/or training program execution.
  • Strong working knowledge of FAA air traffic control operations, procedures, and terminology.
  • Experience developing training materials, lesson plans, presentations, exercises, simulations, job aids, and/or performance assessments.
  • Experience delivering instructor-led, virtual, and/or hands-on training.
  • Strong facilitation, presentation, written communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability and willingness to travel 50% in support of program requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to FAA programs or NAS systems.
  • Experience with FAA systems, federal modernization efforts, or mission-critical environments.
  • Previous experience as an Air Traffic Controller, FAA instructor, training specialist, or air traffic operations SME.
  • Experience developing training for air traffic management, automation, surveillance, communications, navigation, information display, or other NAS-related systems.
  • Experience conducting training needs assessments, gap analyses, curriculum development, and training effectiveness evaluations.
  • Experience developing or delivering simulation-based and scenario-based training.
  • Experience supporting large-scale federal technology modernization or mission-critical system deployments.
  • Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital training technologies.
  • Ability to translate complex operational and technical concepts into training that is clear and understandable to diverse audiences.
  • Professional certifications or formal education in instructional design, adult learning, training development, or related discipline.

#BNATC

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.excerpt: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career?
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Senior Analyst on the Risk Analytics team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll own the identification and mitigation of account takeover (ATO) and scam risk across the Coinbase ecosystem. You'll build critical defenses that protect our users and platform integrity, using data to drive risk decisions that impact millions of customers. This is a high-impact role where you'll define risk metrics, shape prevention strategies, and partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to stay ahead of evolving threats.

What you'll do:

  • Own end-to-end risk controls for ATO and scam prevention, scaling processes to maintain coverage as the business expands into new products and regions.
  • Define risk success metrics, build reporting frameworks, and drive continuous improvement by identifying and prioritizing control enhancements.
  • Leverage data to assess risk and make decisions impacting large customer segments, measuring and quantifying associated tradeoffs through rigorous analysis.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to develop custom risk management strategies and techniques across the Coinbase product suite.
  • Synthesize data findings into clear narratives and recommendations that influence senior risk and product leadership decisions.
  • Investigate and mitigate fraudulent and scam activities by reviewing alerts on anomalous customer and transaction behavior.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of hands-on risk experience in e-commerce or financial services, with at least 2 years focused on combating ATO and scams in a Fraud, Trust and Safety, or Account Security function.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in data analysis using SQL and Python, including working with large-scale databases.
  • Proficiency with business intelligence and data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Superset) to build dashboards and reporting frameworks.
  • Proven ability to independently scope and deliver analytics projects while collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams.
  • Familiarity with blockchain analytics and fraud trends within the cryptocurrency ecosystem.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Durham, NC, USA
jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Think you’re a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

We are growing rapidly and excited to support our clients’ nursing staff in the field by leveraging our remote team of nurses to manage after-hours care delivery. Our triage nurses become an extension of our clients’ care team, and they trust us to support them and their patients during their non-core hours. Learn more at www.intellatriage.com.

Why Join Us

jobs.description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

As a Senior Consultant in R&D, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value. R&D is a broad area that includes several distinct practices: Clinical Operations, Clinical Data Management, Regulatory, and Pharmacovigilance. You will focus in one of these practices based on your background, interests, and needs of the business. You will build credibility, depth, and relationships in that practice, but staffing will remain fungible across R&D and movement between practices is always permitted.

What You'll Do

  • Project Leadership: Act as the Lead for small-scale projects, managing end-to-end design and delivery of high-quality customer solutions
  • Team Management: Lead project teams of 2–3 consultants, developing your people leadership skills in a project setting
  • Business Development: Drive practice growth by leading proposal development and identifying new opportunities within your engagements
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Solve complex challenges for Life Sciences leaders by leveraging Veeva’s unique data, software, and AI insights
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Support multiple projects across R&D while developing deep expertise in your specific practice

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years in Life Sciences Consulting (Business or Management Consulting preferred)
  • Domain Knowledge: Proven expertise in biopharma ClinOps, ClinData, Regulatory, Safety, or general R&D strategy
  • Analytical Rigor: A strong mindset for both quantitative and qualitative reasoning
  • Communication: Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly to senior stakeholders
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher

Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of Veeva products
  • Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program
  • Unrivaled career progression in a fast-growing, global team

COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)

Contract terms: 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs

Reports to: Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)

Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.

Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need, while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.

We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities. This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s Communications Department, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.
  • Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.
  • Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.
  • Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.
  • Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.
  • Coordinate the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.
  • Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.
  • Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.
  • Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver on goals.
  • Use data and customer insights to refine messaging, content, and strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across business audiences.
  • Work with leadership to set goals and KPIs for Wikimedia Enterprise communications, track results against the growth plan, and share actionable insights with leadership and key stakeholders.

Skills and experience

Required

  • At least 8+ years of communications experience, including experience operating at a senior/lead level with minimal oversight in a tech and/or B2B tech environment or supporting a commercial product line.
  • Proven experience bridging communications and marketing/growth functions — ideally in a role that required translating between brand/editorial priorities and commercial or growth objectives.
  • Experience with developing and executing earned media strategy and thought leadership, building relationships with press, partners, and wider stakeholders to develop a pipeline of coverage across channels and platforms.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, including experience influencing senior and executive stakeholders, with a track record of working effectively across teams with different priorities, cultures, and reporting lines.
  • Sound judgment on reputational risk and sensitivity, particularly when balancing commercial messaging against mission-driven or community-facing considerations.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, with the ability to ramp up quickly and take ownership of a live workflow with minimal onboarding, given the fixed-term nature of this role.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone across formats — from press materials to marketing copy to internal briefing documents.
  • Strong editorial judgment: demonstrable ability to review and shape marketing materials (campaigns, web copy, social, blogs, thought leadership) for voice, tone, and brand consistency.
  • A track record of tying communications to business results: setting metrics, measuring impact (coverage quality, share of voice, inbound demand, pipeline influence) and changing course based on the data.
  • Experience working in a matrixed organization, comfortable with dotted-line reporting and leading through influence and collaboration.
  • Experience working remotely and across multiple time zones and emerging markets.
  • Experience overseeing and managing relationships with external agencies.

Preferred

  • Experience in a nonprofit, open-source, mission-driven, or community-governed organization, especially one with a commercial or earned-revenue arm.
  • Real understanding of AI, how it works, data licensing and content provenance debates
  • Familiarity with the Wikimedia movement, Wikipedia, or free-knowledge/open-content spaces.
  • Background in tech, media, or platform companies navigating AI-related content, licensing, or data issues.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. Pracujemy w standardowych godzinach dopasowanych do rytmu pracy polskich placówek (pn-pt., ok. 8:00-16:00), bez pracy zmianowej.


Kluczowe obszary odpowiedzialności:

  1. Konfigurowanie i wdrażanie u klientów gotowych do pracy głosowych agentów AI (technologia LLM).

  2. Bieżące wsparcie klientów po wdrożeniu.

  3. Monitorowanie i analiza pracy wdrożonych agentów, aby stale je optymalizować.


Twój typowy tydzień może wyglądać tak:

  • Współpracujesz z placówkami, zbierając informacje potrzebne do udanego wdrożenia, i pilnujesz harmonogramu oraz koordynacji projektu.

  • Konfigurujesz i uruchamiasz głosowe agenty AI na platformie Talkie, dbając o płynną i sprawną integrację.

  • Zapewniasz wsparcie po wdrożeniu, tak aby agenty działały optymalnie.

  • Analizujesz rozmowy z produkcji i oceniasz pracę agentów, żeby stale podnosić ich skuteczność.

  • Przygotowujesz raporty, dane i statystyki pokazujące efektywność naszych agentów AI.

  • Współtworzysz materiały onboardingowe, dzięki którym nowi klienci bezproblemowo zaczynają pracę z Talkie.

  • Testujesz i współtworzysz nowe funkcje, umiejętności agentów i zautomatyzowane procesy.

  • Pracujesz ramię w ramię z zespołami wewnętrznymi, napędzając innowacje i poprawiając rezultaty klientów.

Requirements

Pokochasz tę pracę, jeśli…

  • Masz doświadczenie w pracy z klientem (minimum rok).

  • Pasjonuje Cię AI i to, jak może ułatwić pacjentom dostęp do opieki zdrowotnej.

  • Potrafisz być empatyczna/empatyczny i wejść w buty użytkownika.

  • Cenisz i praktykujesz jasną, terminową i bezpośrednią komunikację.

  • Lubisz robić porządek z chaosu, optymalizować i upraszczać.

  • Nie boisz się brać inicjatywy, cenisz samodzielność i możliwość kształtowania swojego otoczenia.

  • Lubisz wiedzieć, jak coś działa, i masz nieustający głód wiedzy.

  • Cenisz dobrą atmosferę w zespole.

  • Mówisz biegle po polsku i swobodnie po angielsku (minimum B2) – pracujemy w międzynarodowym zespole.


Co oferujemy?

  • Konkurencyjne wynagrodzenie i benefity na umowie o pracę lub B2B

  • Pracę z misją, zmieniamy sposób, w jaki pacjenci w Polsce docierają do opieki zdrowotnej

  • Pracę z najnowszą technologią opartą na AI, która jest użyteczna i przyjazna dla klientów i pacjentów

  • Elastyczny tryb pracy, zdalnie, z biura lub hybrydowo

  • Wyposażenie stanowiska pracy w biurze i w domu, łącznie z wygodnym fotelem

  • Benefity, m.in.: kartę Multisport, coroczny wyjazd integracyjny, budżet szkoleniowy

  • Ustrukturyzowany onboarding, który pomoże Ci odnaleźć się w nowym środowisku

  • Mentoring i wsparcie w poznawaniu fascynującego świata AI i projektowania rozmów (conversation design)


Jacy jesteśmy jako zespół?

Jesteśmy przyjaźni, otwarci i bezpośredni, a napędzają nas ciekawość i ambicja. Cenimy nastawienie na rozwój (growth mindset) i traktujemy porażki jako okazję do nauki. Naszą kulturę budujemy na dociekliwości i krytycznym myśleniu. Zadawanie pytań jest mile widziane, a dokładne sprawdzanie faktów to u nas standard. Proaktywnie rozwiązujemy problemy i nie uciekamy od wyzwań: kiedy coś nie działa, nazywamy to po imieniu, proponujemy rozwiązania i naprawiamy, stale ulepszając nasze otoczenie i wyniki.

No i lubimy się też dobrze bawić: tańce do białego rana czy karaoke… w Talkie mamy długą tradycję dobrej zabawy! :)


Nasz proces rekrutacji

Proces rekrutacji odzwierciedla naszą kulturę organizacyjną. Opiera się na szacunku i współpracy. Chcemy stworzyć przyjazną atmosferę, w której możesz być sobą i lepiej nas poznać. Cały proces trwa zwykle 2-4 tygodnie.


Czego możesz się spodziewać

📮 Pierwszy kontakt: Jeśli Twoja aplikacja spełni nasze kryteria, odezwiemy się mailowo lub telefonicznie, żeby umówić rozmowę.

📱 Rozmowa telefoniczna: Porozmawiamy przez telefon 10-15 minut.

👋 Pierwsza rozmowa (online): Spotkamy się na 45-60 minut, żeby sprawdzić Twoje dopasowanie do roli.

💪 Druga rozmowa (online): Spotkamy się online na krótkie case study (60-90 minut).

📞 Sprawdzenie referencji: Poprosimy Cię o listę osób, które mogą udzielić referencji, i zadzwonimy do nich.

🤝 Oferta: Złożymy Ci ofertę lub przekażemy feedback na podstawie rozmów, case study i referencji.

About the role: We are looking for an experienced SAP Data Engineer / SAP ABAP Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and strengthen in-house capabilities in the SAP ecosystem.

This role sits at the intersection of SAP application development, business processes, data integration, and enterprise data engineering.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on SAP ABAP development experience, combined with a good grasp of SAP business processes — preferably SAP Sales & Distribution (SD). You will work closely with SAP functional consultants, business stakeholders, data engineers, and external SAP partners to understand requirements, develop SAP customizations, build data integrations, and enable reliable movement of SAP data into our broader data ecosystem. You are the right candidate if you have a solid SAP ABAP technical foundation, knowledge of the modern SAP tech stack, in particular Data Sphere, and an interest in ensuring SAP integrates well within a modern cloud data environment. You will be given the opportunity to strengthen your Python, SQL, and AWS-related skills.

  • SAP ABAP or relevant SAP certifications.

jobs.title: Director of Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning, VisionFund Internatio
jobs.excerpt: VisionFund is the financial services arm of World Vision, serving vulnerable clients through loans, savings, market access and insurance.
jobs.description:
VisionFund is the financial services arm of World Vision, serving vulnerable clients through loans, savings, market access and insurance. In partnership with World Vision, we enable families to grow their livelihoods in hard to reach, rural locations in 28 countries so that caregivers can create secure futures for their children. We believe in brighter futures for children; empowering families to create incomes and jobs; unlocking economic potential for communities to thrive. Join VisionFund and World Vision as we seek to end intergenerational poverty for the world’s most vulnerable children and families.


Learn more about us: visionfund.org



Overview

VisionFund takes a distinct approach to inclusive financial services, providing impact-first financial products with layered training and delivery through the World Vision partnership, in order to improve outcomes for children in the poorest households. The credibility of our ability to improve household and child well-being rests on the quality of our evidence, which this role directly drives.


The Director, MERL leads the design and delivery of VisionFund’s measurement, evaluation, research and learning function: the monitoring architecture across the network, the client voice instruments that tell us what clients actually experience, the external research partnerships that test our assumptions independently, the internal impact evaluations using quasi-experimental or experimental designs that establish whether VisionFund is causing the changes it claims, the capability of impact staff across the MFI network. These activities underpin the standard of evidence behind every impact claim VisionFund makes (e.g., to a donor, an investor or a board).

The role also carries responsibility for enhancing fundraising capabilities. VisionFund is expanding its institutional and climate-finance fundraising at a point when donors are applying sharply increased scrutiny to measurement design. The postholder leads MERL design for fundraising proposals from qualification onward and builds the joint measurement capability with World Vision that multi-entity bids increasingly require.

This is a new post, created as part of a repositioning of the department’s evidence function. The postholder will help shape the function within the existing establishment.


Key Responsibilities

Monitoring & Evaluation, Client Voice and Measurement Standards

  • Own the design and delivery of VisionFund’s network monitoring & evaluation approach, including indicator architecture, data collection protocols, quality assurance and reporting cadence.
  • Lead the design, implementation and interpretation of client voice surveys across the network — instrument design, sampling strategy and analytical method — working with the Client Insights function, which holds data pipelines, dashboards and analytics delivery.
  • Design the technical standards and methods for impact measurement across the network, for approval by the Global Director, Impact & Engagement, and provide assurance on whether those standards are met in substance.

Measurement for Funding

  • Lead MERL design for institutional, philanthropic and blended-finance funding proposals, engaging from opportunity qualification: results frameworks, indicator selection, evaluation design and fully costed MERL budgets.
  • Advise on go/no-go decisions where measurement obligations cannot credibly be delivered.
  • Build joint measurement capability with World Vision support and field offices.
  • Ensure measurement commitments made at proposal stage are resourced and tracked through implementation.

Research, evidence and theory of change

  • Own and maintain VisionFund’s theory of change and test it against emerging evidence.
  • Set and manage the organisational research agenda, prioritising questions where better evidence would change a decision.
  • Manage VisionFund’s flagship academic research partnership as technical counterpart to external research teams; commission and quality-assure third-party research.
  • Build the evidence base supporting child-level results and the defensibility of child-focused impact claims.
  • Contribute technically to sector method development — publication, technical working groups, peer review — within the external positioning strategy set by the Department Head.

Impact staff capacity building

  • Design and deliver the capability-building approach for impact measurement staff across the MFI network: technical curriculum, coaching, method guidance and tooling support, extended to network staff in regions covered by the counterpart directorate.
  • Manage the measurement consequences of network changes, including closing out reporting obligations for exiting entities and maintaining the integrity of network aggregates across periods.

Team Leadership and Departmental Contribution

  • Lead the MERL team, including performance management, capability development and succession.
  • Foster a Christ-centred, high-performing culture.
  • Establish the routines through which evidence reaches and changes decisions.
  • Contribute to departmental and organisational strategy as a member of the Impact & Engagement senior leadership team.

Knowledge, Skills and Capabilities

Required Professional Experience and Qualifications


  • Graduate-level degree in Economics, Development Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, Evaluation, or a related quantitative discipline, or demonstrably equivalent applied expertise
  • Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role leading MERL, evaluation, research, or impact functions within a multinational NGO, development finance institution, inclusive finance organization, or similarly complex global organization.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the design and implementation of measurement frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and impact-monitoring systems across multi-country or decentralized organizations.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience designing and overseeing MERL components of institutional donor, foundation, climate-finance, or other externally funded proposals, including results frameworks, indicator selection, evaluation design, and budget development.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as a technical counterpart to academic institutions, research organizations, consultants, or external evaluators, including commissioning, quality assurance, interpretation, and application of research findings.
  • Proven experience strengthening technical capability and performance of geographically dispersed teams through coaching, training, curriculum development, and technical guidance.
  • Experience influencing and maintaining quality standards across teams and stakeholders that are not under direct line management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change, establishing, redesigning, or significantly strengthening a MERL, research, or evidence function.
  • Evidence of external technical contribution through publications, conference presentations, participation in technical working groups, peer review, or other recognized sector contributions.
  • Proven experience leading and developing diverse professional teams, including performance management, talent development, succession planning, and fostering high-performance cultures.
  • Fluent in English. Working French or Spanish desirable.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience of inclusive finance, microfinance or financial services measurement.
  • Working familiarity with social performance and client protection frameworks sufficient to interface effectively with the function, which sits in the counterpart directorate.
  • Familiarity with climate adaptation results frameworks and the measurement requirements of major climate and adaptation funds, including their theory-of-change and paradigm-shift expectations.
  • Experience designing MEL for adaptation or resilience programming where attribution is structurally difficult.
  • Experience with World Vision International or another large, federated INGO.

Travel and/or Work Environment Requirement

Home based role with 20% travel


For positions filled in the United States, the typical salary range for this role is $102,000 to $140,000 USD. Ranges are based on various factors, including the labor market, job type, job level, internal equity and budget. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience and geographic location.

Applicant Types Accepted:

Local Applicants Only

World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.

deine aufgaben

Wir suchen einen System Engineer mit Schwerpunkt Firewall und Netzwerksicherheit, der unsere Kunden bei
der Umsetzung und dem Betrieb von Security-Lösungen unterstützt.
Wir betreuen mittelständische und Enterprise-Kunden im Bereich Netzwerk- und IT-Security. Du übernimmst
die Umsetzung und Inbetriebnahme von Firewall-Umgebungen bei unseren Kunden.

Deine Aufgaben: Umsetzung, Rollout & Problemlösung

  • Hands-on Implementierung: Du übernimmst die technische Umsetzung, den Austausch und den Rollout von Firewall-Lösungen bei unseren Kunden
  • Konfiguration & Go-Live: Du erstellst und optimierst Regelwerke, richtest VPN-Verbindungen ein (Site-to-Site, Client-to-Site) und konfigurierst NAT sowie Security-Features wie IPS/IDS oder Webfilter
  • Troubleshooting & Analyse: Bei Störungen oder Auffälligkeiten im Netzwerk übernimmst du die Analyse (3rd Level), wertest Logs aus und findest nachhaltige Lösungen
  • Dokumentation: Du dokumentierst die Umgebungen sauber und nachvollziehbar für Kunden und Team
  • Projektrealisierung im Team: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Senior Engineers und Consultants zusammen und setzt gemeinsam auch komplexe Security-Projekte um

dein profil

Zuverlässiger Macher mit Security-Fokus

  • Du bringst eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration) mit und hast praktische Erfahrung im Bereich Network Security und Firewalls.
  • Hersteller-Wissen: Du fühlst dich idealerweise in den Welten von Palo Alto, Sophos, Watchguard oder Fortinet zu Hause. Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis von Netzwerkprotokollen und -technologien (Routing, Switching, TCP/IP).
  • Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert und bringst Themen zuverlässig zum Abschluss.
  • Du kommst mit Kunden gut zurecht – vor Ort oder remote.
  • Du arbeitest gern im Team und möchtest dich fachlich weiterentwickeln.

deine zukunft bei uns im unternehmen

Warum bei uns? Was dich erwartet

  • Du siehst direkt das Ergebnis deiner Arbeit – die von dir umgesetzten Umgebungen gehen produktiv bei unseren Kunden in Betrieb.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen zusammen und kannst jederzeit Rückfragen klären.
  • wir unterstützen dich bei Weiterbildungen und Hersteller-Zertifizierungen (Palo Alto, Sophos, Fortinet).
  • Du arbeitest in unterschiedlichen Kundenumgebungen statt nur in einer internen IT

Wir bieten Dir spannende Aufgaben in einem attraktiven und abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsumfeld:
  • Team: Der Zusammenhalt innerhalb unseres vielseitigen Teams zeichnet uns durch hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, Team- und Firmenevents sowie ein familiäre Arbeitsatmosphäre aus
  • Modern Workplace: Am Arbeitsplatz der Zukunft erhältst Du neuestes Technikequipment und arbeitest in einem innovativen Arbeitsumfeld

jobs.description:
Employment Type

  • Fully remote - any US state
  • Direct, full-time employment with Mobiz IT, Inc.
  • Third-party agency submissions are not accepted.

Role Summary

The Staff Accountant owns the recurring transactional accounting and reconciliation work that drives Mobiz’s monthly close, performed end-to-end in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. This is an ownership role, not a support role: you prepare and reconcile; you don’t just assist.

Mobiz is a global IT consulting and Microsoft licensing firm operating across multiple legal entities and currencies. Revenue and costs are tracked dimensionally — every customer is a department, every engagement is a project code — so accurate coding on every entry is essential to reliable customer and project profitability reporting.

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close and Journal Entries

  • Prepare and post the recurring close journal entries: revenue deferrals on multi-month and annual license contracts, expense accruals, prior-month accrual reversals, and prepaid amortization.
  • Prepare vendor rebate allocation entries and distribute rebate income to the correct customer departments.
  • Code every entry with the full dimension set — department, project, and site — and attach supporting documentation in Business Central before submitting.
  • Route all entries to the Controller for approval before posting; maintain the approved-entry archive in SharePoint.
  • Track close tasks against the published close calendar and flag at-risk items early. Reducing close cycle time is an explicit goal of this role.

Reconciliations

  • Reconcile operating bank accounts, corporate credit cards, brokerage accounts, and the line of credit monthly, moving toward a weekly continuous-reconciliation cadence.
  • Validate direct bank feeds into Business Central against source statement exports and resolve sync gaps.
  • Create correcting entries for unrecorded items — fees, interest, and timing differences — and clear each account to a zero difference before posting.
  • Reconcile AR and AP aging to the balance sheet, and reconcile prepaid, accrual, and deferred revenue accounts each month.

Multi-Entity and Intercompany

  • Prepare intercompany cross-charge entries between Mobiz entities on the close schedule, referencing the governing agreement in each entry description.
  • Reconcile due-to / due-from balances and resolve imbalances before period close.
  • Support foreign-currency transactions and translation at approved rates.

Cost Allocation and Customer Profitability

  • Own the monthly payroll allocation: pull time data from ServiceNow, run it through the allocation model, and reallocate wages and payroll taxes from administrative accounts to the customer departments and COGS accounts that earned them.
  • Validate that total allocated equals total payroll before submitting the entry.
  • Maintain separation of billable and non-billable cost so gross margin by customer stays accurate.

Reporting and Analysis

  • Produce monthly P&L by department and prepare variance analysis comparing the current month to the prior three months, investigating and documenting every variance above 5%.
  • Analyze gross margin by customer and surface trends and anomalies to the Controller.
  • Validate the reporting package before distribution: active client dimensions, department mappings, zero gross profit on corporate departments, and a balance sheet that nets to zero.
  • Assist with budgeting and forecasting by compiling actuals and identifying trends.

Tax and Compliance Support

  • Prepare and file sales and use tax returns; monitor economic nexus thresholds and register in new jurisdictions as they are met.
  • Assemble schedules and supporting records for the external CPA firm for federal, state, and local filings.
  • Track filing deadlines and maintain the record of submissions and advisor correspondence.
  • Provide documentation and reconciliations for audits and due diligence requests.

Controls and Continuous Improvement

  • Follow established internal controls, approval thresholds, and documentation standards without exception.
  • Document procedures and identify automation candidates in Business Central and Power Automate that remove manual steps from the close.

Business Central Requirements

Direct, hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Business Central is required. You must have a minimum of 3 years of experience working independently in:

  • General journals, batch import of journal entries, and posting.
  • Bank Account Reconciliation and Payment Reconciliation Journals under Cash Management.
  • Dimensions and dimension values — assigning, correcting, and filtering by them.
  • Chart of accounts navigation and financial report / account schedule export to Excel.
  • Standard financial statements: trial balance, P&L, and balance sheet with dimension filters.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of progressive accounting experience, including ownership of month-end close tasks.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, including revenue recognition for subscription and multi-period contracts, accruals, and deferrals.
  • Minimum of 2 years of hands-on Dynamics 365 Business Central experience as described above.
  • Demonstrated accuracy under deadline, with the judgment to escalate rather than assume.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in IT services, consulting, software resale, or another project-based business.
  • Multi-entity, multi-currency, or intercompany accounting experience.
  • Exposure to ServiceNow, Power BI, Power Automate, or Power Query.
  • CPA candidate or actively pursuing licensure.

Success in the Role

  • 30 days — Independently reconcile assigned bank and credit card accounts and post approved recurring entries.
  • 60 days — Own payroll allocation and intercompany cross-charge entries end-to-end.
  • 90 days — Deliver monthly variance analysis with documented explanations and identify at least one opportunity to improve the close cycle.

Compensation and Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, and retirement.

Mobiz IT, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer.

Veeva Compass delivers record-level prescription and medical claims data to power longitudinal, de-identified patient analytics for commercial use cases—including patient journey, market landscape, and provider engagement.
You will be responsible for driving data quality, consistency, and standardization within the Terminology Reference Library (TRL) by managing reference data for key attributes found across prescription and medical claims—including drug information, ICD-10 diagnosis codes, procedure and lab codes, as well as payer and plan data. In this role, you will query prescription and medical claims datasets to support the evaluation and integration of new inbound data sources into core schemas.   • Execute Quality & Cleansing Workflows: Perform exploratory data analysis to identify discrepancies, handle missing values, execute deduplication, and ensure data completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
  • Continuous Product Improvement: Investigate data anomalies within the Veeva Compass product suite, testing both planned and unplanned data changes to assess downstream customer impact.
  • Build Metrics & Documentation: Develop interactive dashboards to track key data quality metrics, contributing to technical documentation, validation reports, and team process improvements.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

As a Vault CRM Architect, you’ll act as an advisor to key customer stakeholders in the Global Life Sciences industry, helping them deploy Veeva commercial applications in a way that’s aligned with best practices, meets the customer’s needs, and that scales for future growth and innovation.

You’ll act as a Technical lead on implementations of Vault CRM, Events Management, and connected solutions, while also driving migrations of Veeva customer environments from SFDC to Veeva Vault Platform.

What makes us different:

  • High Trust, Ownership & Autonomy: Passion and effort directly lead to opportunities and real ownership from the start
  • Collaboration without competition: peers root for each other’s success, leadership is entirely accessible, and we tackle complex problems with a strict "no-ego" approach
  • Meaningful Industry Impact: know your work makes a difference, by helping life sciences companies operate more efficiently and effectively

The role is ideally based in the area of a Veeva office (Barcelona, London, Paris, Frankfurt, Berlin), but other EU locations will be considered.

Full right to work in the country of application is required.

What You'll Do

  • Drive End-to-End Delivery: Own and collaborate on implementation and migration projects across SMB and Enterprise accounts, as a Functional Lead, Architect, Configurator, or Stream Lead
  • Act as the Technical Authority: Confidently lead meetings with senior IT and Business stakeholders. Guide decisions based on best-practices, architectural principles and domain and technical expertise. Mentor internal teams and provide support to implementation partners
  • Stay Hands-on: You prefer to know how things work under the hood. While you do not have to configure everything yourself every day, you love to configure, fix tricky issues, and help the team solve deep technical problems when they arise
  • Create Solutions: You see ambiguity and unknowns as exciting puzzles, not blockers. Turning open-ended problems into clear action plans and driving them forward is what gives you energy
  • Push the Boundaries: You never settle.You are curious about technology and love testing new AI tools. You enjoy finding smart solutions and making work easier for your team

Requirements

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in IT Consulting / Architecture for implementation projects
  • Strong consulting background with proven ability to drive best practices, and manage senior stakeholder relationships
  • Proven ability to learn new technology fast, and take ownership of complex technical outcomes
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment across multiple assignments
  • Able to travel approximately 20%
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken)

Nice to Have

  • Demonstrated expertise building, configuring, and architecting on Veeva Vault, Veeva CRM, or the Salesforce (Force.com) platform
  • Proficiency in SQL, MDL, Python
  • Experience with software from other vendors (IQVIA, SAP, CVENT, etc)
  • Professional fluency in German, French, Spanish, or Italian
  • Experience working with the Pharmaceutical, Consumer Health or an adjacent industry

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A practical case exercise
    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

As a Data Scientist in our EU Analytics practice, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.
You will play a pivotal role in building advanced analytical models and methodologies, integrating Veeva Data Cloud products with complex European healthcare data assets. You will drive innovation across our analytical offerings, ensuring Veeva remains at the forefront of data-led, tech-enabled Life Sciences commercial models. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to bridge technical modeling with practical business insights across European markets. You will take ownership of any of our analytics assets (e.g., design solution, manage expectations, status accountancy, impact measurement).

  • Collaborate closely in integrated, cross-functional teams alongside product managers, data engineers, operations, and consultants to deliver end-to-end analytical solutions and ensure continuous feedback and iteration
  • Maintain clear documentation of data methodologies, model architectures, and validation processes to ensure defensibility, scalability, and transparency across client engagements

Requirements

  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with a track record of collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams. Skilled at translating complex technical challenges to non-technical stakeholders, driving impactful problem-solving sessions, and championing a pragmatic approach to solution design
  • Strong technical expertise across Python, SQL, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI, with a proven ability to design and implement predictive models and intelligent algorithms that solve complex business problems
  • You bring Experience writing process documentation, technical specifications, and data collection guidelines to ensure quality, scalability, and repeatability across projects

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
  • Languages in addition to English
  • Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
  • Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
  • Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines) and automation tools such as Apache Airflow
  • Familiarity with cloud based computing resources such as AWS

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.excerpt: About MoodMood is a category-defining omni-channel hemp brand offering a full product suite across DTC online and retail partners.
jobs.description:
About Mood

Mood is a category-defining omni-channel hemp brand offering a full product suite across DTC online and retail partners. We are scaling fast and doing it profitably. We win through a premium product experience that brings best-in-class shopping to one of the most highly regulated industries. Our mission is simple: Enable access to premium hemp products of the highest quality, conveniently.

We are still early in our journey, and the right people can make a lasting impact. As we continue to grow and build new ventures, our data function supports an increasingly broad range of business needs.

We operate in a highly regulated and evolving environment. The rules around advertising, tracking, and selling can change quickly, and our data function must be able to adapt with them.

About the Role

As Head of Data, you'll own Mood's data function end to end. You'll lead the team while staying hands-on in the work, not just directing it.

Your job is to turn data into decisions that improve profitability. You'll prioritize work based on its impact on revenue, cost, and risk—and say no to the rest. You'll write and review SQL and models and work hands-on with AI tools, including AI coding tools, to operate with the leverage of a much larger team.

If you'd rather manage from a distance or solve most problems by adding people, this role won't suit you. If you want to own the whole function, keep your hands in the code, step up without being asked, and see your analysis change what the business does, it will.

What You'll Own

  • Strategy & Roadmap: Determine what the team works on, in what order, and what it turns down. You'll establish how requests come in and get ranked and keep leadership and the team clear on priorities, tradeoffs, and capacity.
  • Warehouse & Pipelines: Own BigQuery, Dataform models, and ingestion from the systems the business runs on.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Own the dashboards and analysis teams use to make decisions.
  • Measurement & Attribution: Own the in-house attribution model, incrementality tests, and the data behind server-side conversion tracking, built with Marketing and kept sound as the rules on tracking change.
  • Data Quality: Catch bad data before it reaches a report or a decision.
  • Access & Governance: Determine which people and AI agents can access which data, including sensitive customer data.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

  • You've ranked data initiatives by their revenue or cost impact and said no to work that falls below the line.
  • Customer segmentation and lifecycle analytics, including email, are actively helping grow revenue from existing customers.
  • Data is kept safe: access is tightly controlled, AI agents operate on production data within clear guardrails, and sensitive customer data receives the strictest handling.
  • You understand what each tool in the data stack does, what it costs, and where it adds value—and you've made your first build-vs-buy decisions.

First 6 Months

  • Marketing trusts the in-house attribution model, and incrementality tests are reliable enough to inform spend decisions.
  • Orders and revenue reconcile across Shopify, the ERP, and Finance, while inventory aging and demand planning operate from the same trusted data.
  • You've reduced the cost of the data stack by consolidating or removing tools where it makes financial and operational sense.
  • Every team works from one trusted set of numbers: certified metrics in the semantic layer used consistently across dashboards, analysts, and our internal data bot.

What You'll Work With

  • Cloud & Warehouse: Google Cloud, BigQuery
  • Transformation: Dataform
  • Semantic Layer: Cube
  • Ingestion: Airbyte, dlt, Prefect
  • Experimentation: Statsig
  • Tracking: GA4, plus server-side tracking
  • Business Systems: Shopify (headless), Klaviyo, Salesforce, Xoro (ERP)
  • Reporting: Internal dashboards
  • AI: Claude Code and an internal data bot that answers questions from certified queries

You'll decide what stays, what goes, and what gets built.

Who You'll Work With

  • The Head of Finance, your manager, on reconciliation, inventory, demand planning, and the cost of the data stack.
  • The CEO, on the revenue and cost decisions your work informs.
  • Your team: a small team across analytics, data engineering, and analysis, plus specialist contractors.
  • Teams across the business that rely on the numbers, including Marketing, Operations, and each sales channel.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in data or analytics, including 3+ years leading a data function or team.
  • You've written SQL and worked hands-on in a modern cloud data warehouse within the last two years.
  • You've built data models using dbt, Dataform, or a similar framework, as well as data pipelines.
  • You use AI tools every day in your hands-on data work, including to write and review code, with appropriate review processes and access guardrails in place.
  • You have a track record of data work that influenced revenue or cost decisions, and you can quantify the impact.
  • You've made build-vs-buy decisions you can defend and significantly reduced tooling or infrastructure costs, with measurable savings.
  • You manage up effectively and communicate clearly with executives.
  • You turn complex analysis into clear charts and concise recommendations that leadership acts on.
  • You can move easily between very different types of work, from attribution and experimentation to dashboards and data infrastructure.
  • You reason through unfamiliar problems from first principles rather than relying on assumptions.
  • You're comfortable leading a small team while remaining hands-on in the technical work.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a regulated industry such as hemp/cannabis, alcohol, or supplements, particularly with marketing attribution and tracking under regulatory constraints.
  • Analytics experience in an e-commerce, DTC, or similar consumer business.
  • Experience with Shopify event tracking, especially on a headless storefront.
  • Experience with identity stitching, attribution, MMM, or incrementality testing.
  • Experience with semantic layers such as Cube.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience working with finance data, including reconciliation and inventory.

Location

Remote, with a preference for candidates located in New York, San Francisco, or Los Angeles.

Compensation

$150,000–$250,000 base salary

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law. All employment is based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

Mood is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical or mental disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please contact HR and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.
