LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Pulaar-English Phone Interpreter

Job Title: Pulaar Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in Canada

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.70 - $0.85 per minute

We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:

The PulaarTelephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Pulaarand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inPulaarand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

    • Kaspersky products.

Job Title: Karenni Interpreter

Position Overview:

The Karenni Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Karenni and English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.

The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.

This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**

Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inKarenni and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Partner Implementation & Enablement team is responsible for bringing new bank and credit union partners onto our platform and keeping existing partners equipped to run their lending programs. We own the operational core of the partner relationship: the diligence materials partners use to evaluate us, the change management process that tells them when our policies and models change, and the systems that deliver both. How quickly a partner can launch, and how much confidence they have in us once they have launched, is decided by this team’s work.

As the Diligence Program Lead at Upstart, you will own the diligence and change management programs our lending partners depend on. You will answer the due diligence questionnaires that partners and their examiners require, maintain the document library and access controls behind them, and run the recurring process that notifies partners when our policies, procedures, and models change. You will work across Compliance, Lending Partnerships, Account Management, and Product to turn a set of manual, individually held processes into programs that hold up as the partner base grows.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Own the lending partner change management program end to end: assemble each release, notify partners of policy, procedure, and model updates, and keep the supporting document libraries current.
  • Respond to lending partner due diligence questionnaires and information requests, working with Compliance, Legal, and Model Risk Management to source and verify every answer.
  • Maintain the partner-facing document repository and its access controls, including which materials each partner can reach based on their product mix and stage in the relationship.
  • Run the recurring corrective action reporting cycle: validate the source data, distribute partner-specific reports, and confirm delivery with the teams that publish them.
  • Work with Product to move manual diligence and change management workflows onto supported tooling, and document each process so more than one person can run it.
  • Identify gaps in policy ownership and documentation approval status, and raise them with Compliance and Lending Partnerships before they reach a partner.

Minimum Qualificationsu

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
  • 5 years of experience in financial services compliance, risk, audit, or third-party due diligence
  • 2 years of experience responding to due diligence questionnaires, regulatory examinations, or audit requests from banks, credit unions, or other regulated institutions
  • Experience owning a recurring operational or reporting process end to end, including its documentation
  • Experience administering a document management system, virtual data room, or other controlled-access content repository

We are hiring a Venture Partner to bring new opportunities into Pairs, and to grow the network of investors who see them first.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

This role works across both sides of Pairs. You bring in companies worth our diligence, and you grow the network of investors who back them directly.

This role is for people who bring in deals on their own. You already have an active network of founders who are raising, and investors who write direct cheques. Here you open new relationships on both sides every month, using the same approach that built your existing ones.

We are not raising a fund. Our investors invest directly in companies, so the work is about family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angels, not fund LPs.

Our platform handles the pipeline, research and follow-up. Your time goes to founder and investor conversations, and to judging which opportunities deserve the network's attention.

You will work directly with the two co-founders and our investor team. The organisation is flat, so you will see first-hand how we screen opportunities, what we decline and why.

Your current title matters less than the quality of your relationships. We are looking for someone who has built those relationships personally and can explain exactly how.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

  • New opportunities. Companies raising Series A and later, brought to Pairs with the context our team needs to assess them.

  • Network growth. New relationships every month with family offices, high-net-worth individuals and angel investors who are new to Pairs.

  • Investor matching. A clear understanding of what each investor looks for, so the opportunities you share are relevant.

  • Your relationships. The founders and investors you bring, kept current and qualified. They remain yours.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

  • Have an active network of founders you can bring to the table yourself, and direct investor relationships you built personally.

  • Have brought at least one company or investor into a private round, and can walk us through how it happened.

  • Understand what makes a company worth an investor's time: stage, traction, round structure, and the reasons investors pass.

  • Treat discretion as second nature. Please do not include any investor or company names in your application.

  • Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

Position Summary

Help shape the future of design at CLEAResult by enriching our design system in Claude Design and building AI-powered, self-serve templates that let teams across the company create their own on-brand materials without waiting on a one-off request. Alongside that, bring CLEAResult's brand to life across everything Growth Marketing creates: brand materials, sales materials, social content, web work, and motion graphics. You'll create eye-catching, on-brand work across both static and motion formats that helps grow CLEAResult's reputation and pipeline with the utilities we want to work with, and you'll direct contract and freelance designers as needed to support production capacity.

Note for candidates: this is a brand and marketing design role, not a UX or product design role. Web design work includes both the public site and internal SharePoint properties.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support the ongoing enrichment of CLEAResult's design system in Claude Design, building AI-powered, self-serve templates that let teams across the company produce their own on-brand materials, and move the team from one-off production toward scalable systems.
  • Own brand governance (via Frontify), including the ongoing brand modernization project.
  • Lead website and SharePoint design.
  • Direct contract and freelance designers as needed, maintaining a reliable bench for production capacity.
  • Triage and prioritize the significant volume of ad hoc creative requests that come from other departments. Recent team data shows meaningful time going to Bid & Proposal Support, Corporate Communications decks, Canada/regional marketing, and People/HR materials, alongside core Growth Marketing work.
  • Partner with the Senior Director and the team's project manager on delivering the creative queue cohesively, sequencing and batching work so that high-volume ad hoc requests do not crowd out core Growth Marketing priorities.

First 90 Days

jobs.excerpt: About AMZ Advisers:AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces.
jobs.description:
About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

Job Summary

The Professional Services Consultant (PSC) – Cortex XSIAM is a high-impact technical and consultative role responsible for delivering end-to-end Security Operations Center (SOC) modernization across both SIEM and SOAR capabilities. In this role, you will guide enterprise customers through seamless log migration, design robust threat detection strategies, and engineer advanced security automation playbooks within the Cortex XSIAM platform. By combining deep expertise in SIEM log ingestion, detection engineering, and Python-based automation, you will empower customers to optimize their incident response capabilities and elevate their overall security posture.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and execute step-by-step strategies for onboarding, ingesting, and parsing log sources into Cortex XSIAM.
  • Build and fine-tune correlation and detection rules to identify emerging threats across endpoint, network, and cloud environments.
  • Monitor and tune log source performance, ingestion rates, and detection logic to enhance system efficiency.
  • Analyze manual SOC processes and transform them into automated, scalable workflows using XSIAM automation playbooks.
  • Write custom Python integrations to connect Cortex XSIAM with third-party security tools and RESTful APIs.
  • Deploy and manage content packs, custom layouts, and automated dashboards tailored to customer security use cases.
  • Serve as a trusted SME on Cortex XSIAM, SIEM log architecture, correlation logic, and SOAR automation best practices.
  • Partner with security stakeholders to define security metrics and strategic automation roadmaps.
  • Conduct technical workshops and produce technical design documentation to enable long-term customer autonomy.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience deploying, integrating, and managing enterprise SIEM solutions like Splunk, IBM QRadar, or Microsoft Sentinel.
  • 4+ years of direct experience with SOC tooling, incident response lifecycles, and security analysis across cloud, endpoint, and network layers.
  • Proven experience building playbooks, configuring correlation rules, and managing content and integrations within the Cortex ecosystem.
  • Proficiency in Python for security tool integration and automation scripting, combined with strong Regex capabilities for log parsing.
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs, JSON data structures, and third-party security integrations.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with a track record of authoring clear technical design documentation.
  • Strong analytical mindset capable of troubleshooting complex technical workstreams and integration flows independently.
  • Proactive, consultative approach to understanding customer challenges and translating them into actionable engineering requirements.
  • Ability to travel occasionally (up to 10%) for on-site customer meetings, strategic workshops, and technical kickoffs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Palo Alto Networks credentials (e.g., PCNSE, PCDRA, or specialized XSOAR/XSIAM certifications).
  • Broader industry credentials such as CISSP, GIAC, or vendor SIEM qualifications.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.description:
Product Designer, End User Experience (Autofill)

Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California. Learn more at .

Bitwarden is hiring a Product Designer to focus on autofill within our End User Experience team. Autofill is one of the most common ways people use Bitwarden, whether they are individuals, families, or employees at a business. You will design how Bitwarden fills logins, passkeys, cards, and identities across browsers, desktop, and mobile, and how it prompts users to save and update their credentials. You will work with product managers, engineers, and other designers, and you will use AI tools as a regular part of your process. We want someone who understands cybersecurity and wants to make security products easier to use.

This is a remote role. Candidates must be based in the U.S., and we prefer time zones that overlap with the U.S. East Coast. Please include a link to your portfolio when you apply.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design autofill experiences for individual, Premium, Families, and Business users across the browser extension, desktop app, and iOS and Android apps
  • Improve how users fill logins, passkeys, verification codes, payment cards, and identity information on websites and in apps
  • Design the prompts that ask users to save a new login or update a changed password
  • Design for difficult cases, such as multi-step logins, unusual login forms, and sites where autofill does not work as expected
  • Work within iOS and Android autofill frameworks and browser limitations so autofill behaves consistently on every platform
  • Help users understand when Bitwarden will and will not autofill, and why, so they can avoid phishing sites
  • Create user flows, prototypes, and production-ready designs using the Bitwarden design system
  • Use AI design tools to facilitate and scale research, ideation, rapid prototyping, and iteration
  • Collaborate with our product teams to explore emerging product concepts, including agentic workflows
  • Help run user interviews and usability tests, and review user feedback and support trends to improve autofill
  • Present work in design critiques and to product and engineering partners

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • 2+ years of experience in product design or equivalent experience
  • A portfolio that shows end-to-end design work on digital products
  • Strong interaction design skills, including sketching, wireframing, and prototyping
  • Proficiency in Figma and experience working within a component-based design system
  • Experience using AI tools in your design work, such as Claude, ChatGPT, V0, or Figma AI, and the ability to write effective prompts
  • Front-end development experience or experience prototyping in code with AI tools
  • Interest in designing AI features and an understanding of the usability and trust issues they can create
  • An understanding of and passion for cybersecurity, online privacy, and open source
  • Close attention to detail in small interactions that people see many times a day
  • The ability to design for users with a wide range of technical knowledge
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative working style

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Experience designing autofill, password management, or authentication experiences
  • Experience designing browser extensions
  • Familiarity with iOS and Android autofill frameworks and native platform conventions
  • Familiarity with passkeys and how websites structure login and checkout forms
  • Experience designing cybersecurity, identity, or privacy products
  • Experience designing AI-powered features
  • Familiarity with Angular component libraries and accessibility guidelines such as WCAG

DESIGN AT BITWARDEN

The Product Design team at Bitwarden makes it simple for people of all skill levels to manage sensitive data. We give users clear options and guide them toward good security habits. We keep our experiences consistent and transparent so people can trust Bitwarden with their data and feel confident using it.

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

Selected candidates will be invited to schedule an introduction call and potentially progress through the following stages:

  • Meeting with our Recruiting team
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager
  • Portfolio review with team members
  • Interview with the Design Director
  • References

Successful candidates will be asked to authorize and complete a background check. We do not discriminate based on having a criminal record, and we encourage candidates to be open with us about anything that may come up on the report so we can discuss in advance and determine the impact on the role and company.

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

  • The Bitwarden user community loves staying secure, and the feeling is mutual. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose and bring a more secure internet experience to everyone, from friends and family to the world's largest organizations.
  • Become an expert. You'll become immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open-source software.
  • Bitwarden remains dedicated to building a diverse and talented team. Work remotely with a motivated and supportive team of colleagues worldwide.
  • Learn and grow. Take on new challenges with the support of your team, and join the Bitwarden #growth-club to continue personal and professional development.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are the team behind KitBash3D, Greyscalegorilla, ArtStation, and Sketchfab, united to amplify human creativity.

Our creative ecosystem gives artists and studios across film, games, motion design, and digital media access to a connected collection of 3D assets, tools, platforms, and communities. Globally, our products support millions of creators, including independent artists and creative teams.

KitBash is building an ecosystem that supports digital creators at every step of their journey from inspiration to finished work, making it easier to learn, build, collaborate, and showcase.

We’re at an exciting stage of growth, bringing together passionate people across technology, design, marketing, and storytelling to shape the future of 3D creation. We’d love for you to be part of it.

About the Role

KitBash recently acquired ArtStation and Sketchfab and brought on a new Business Development team. As we build out how we sell across the new business units, we're looking for a freelance Salesforce Administrator to lead a modernization project in our Sales Cloud org, then stay on for lighter ongoing support. We run one org (Sales Cloud, Enterprise Edition) shared across all of our brands, with fewer than 10 users. It's lightly customized: a few custom record types, a good number of custom fields, and a handful of Flows.

We're looking for an experienced consultant to work alongside our COO to clear the cobwebs in the existing instance and get us ready to support a larger team and more complex sales motions. This work will include updating sales processes, setting up integrations with Maxio, Pandadocs, and other tools, modernizing the look and feel of the application, and working with the Business Development team to translate business requirements into working configuration

Engagement details

  • This is a remote contract role, the scope of work will be split into 3 phases:
    • Phase 1 Discovery and design: Deliver a future-state design with scope and implementation plan.
    • Phase 2 Future-state implementation: Complete development environment with change set to be approved and deployed.
    • Phase 3 Ongoing support and maintenance.

What You'll Contribute

  • Audit and document the current state of the org
  • Set up a safe change process. We work in production only today. Stand up a sandbox and a simple deploy practice (change sets or similar), document it, and train our team to run it on their own once the engagement ends.
  • Work with the Business Development team to gather and refine requirements for ArtStation/Sketchfab sales workflows, starting from their existing mockups, and turn them into production-ready configuration: record types, page layouts, fields, and Flows.
  • Scope, set up, and document integrations between Salesforce and other business applications (e.g. Maxio, Pandadocs, etc.), including data mapping, sync rules, and error handling, so the team can monitor and maintain them after handoff.
  • Modernize the user experience: Lightning pages, Dynamic Forms, a cleaner layout, and home pages and dashboards the sales team will actually use.
  • Find repetitive manual work and automate it with Flow.
  • Evaluate AppExchange apps where they'd save real time, with clear cost and tradeoff recommendations.
  • Lead data cleanup: deduplication, standardizing fields, and validation rules to keep data clean going forward.

What You Bring to the Team

  • 5+ years hands-on Salesforce Sales Cloud admin/consulting experience in small to mid-sized companies
  • Salesforce Administrator certification required; Platform App Builder or Advanced Admin a plus
  • Strong Flow skills and a declarative-first mindset. We want someone who reaches for configuration before code and says so when code is actually warranted.
  • Comfortable working directly with an executive stakeholder: you explain tradeoffs plainly, push back when there's a better approach, and don't need hand-holding
  • Disciplined about documentation and change control
  • Bonus: experience with multi-brand orgs, B2B plus B2C sales motions, or marketplace/creator businesses

Social Content & Growth Strategist
Fully Remote Work From Home Role
Compensation Based on Experience

Role

Our client is a comic and entertainment company looking for a hands on Social Content & Growth Strategist to help build audiences around their characters, stories, digital products, games, and upcoming entertainment projects.

This is not a traditional social media manager role. They need someone who can research what is working, generate original ideas, create content, direct a graphics team, publish, analyze results, and continually evolve the strategy.

You should be equally comfortable coming up with a meme, editing a Reel, researching why an account is suddenly growing, building next week’s content calendar, and looking at analytics to determine what to try next.

They are looking for someone curious, resourceful, organized, creatively ambitious, and deeply familiar with how internet culture and social platforms actually work today.

What You'll Do

Creative & Content

  • Develop original concepts for memes, static posts, carousels, short-form videos, character content, and recurring social series.
  • Turn concepts into finished, publishable content using the company’s existing artwork and assets.
  • Write strong captions, hooks, headlines, and short-form copy in distinct character voices.
  • Edit short-form videos and create social-first graphics.
  • Use AI-assisted creative tools intelligently while ensuring finished content feels intentional, polished, and human rather than generically AI-generated.
  • Identify opportunities to repurpose comics, animation, games, trailers, and other existing assets into social content.

Growth & Research

  • Constantly research emerging social formats, platform changes, algorithm behavior, creators, entertainment brands, fandoms, memes, and cultural trends.
  • Identify what’s driving growth for other accounts and translate those observations into experiments the team can run.
  • Develop strategies for reaching non-followers through shares, recommendations, collaborations, creators, trends, and other organic distribution.
  • Find relevant creators, communities, accounts, and potential collaborators.
  • Proactively bring new growth ideas to the team rather than waiting for assignments.

Publishing & Organization

  • Own and maintain the social content calendar.
  • Schedule and publish consistently across active accounts.
  • Keep assets, drafts, approvals, captions, and publishing schedules organized.
  • Coordinate with designers, animators, editors, and other team members for assets as needed.
  • Help manage multiple distinct social accounts.

Analytics & Experimentation

  • Track reach, non-follower reach, engagement, shares, saves, watch time, profile visits, follower growth, clicks, and other relevant metrics.
  • Identify which content and formats are actually driving discovery and audience growth.
  • Run small experiments, evaluate the results, and quickly iterate.
  • Provide simple, actionable reporting focused on what worked, what didn’t, why, and what should be done next.
  • As the company’s commerce ecosystem grows, help connect social performance to digital product sales, game engagement, email acquisition, and app growth.

What we're looking for

  • Strong understanding of Instagram/Meta and TikTok, particularly short-form content and organic discovery.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally create compelling social content, not simply manage other creators.
  • Strong copywriting instincts and a good sense of humor.
  • Fluency in memes, internet culture, entertainment, fandoms, creators, and emerging social trends.
  • Comfortable with Canva and/or Adobe tools, plus short-form video editing software.
  • Experience using modern AI creative tools is strongly preferred.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several content streams simultaneously.
  • Analytical enough to understand performance data without losing the creative instinct behind great content.
  • Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out independently.
  • Proactive — someone who brings ideas and opportunities to the team rather than needing a detailed assignment for every task.

Most importantly: The client is less interested in years of experience than in evidence that you understand how audiences grow today and can turn that understanding into actual content. Know how to learn.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first few months, the client expects this person to help establish consistent publishing across their accounts, develop recognizable content formats for individual characters, improve non-follower reach and organic discovery, identify repeatable growth opportunities, and create a faster feedback loop between research → idea → content → performance → next experiment.

The larger goal is to turn the company’s social channels into an audience engine that supports its characters, digital products, games, original shows, and ultimately the broader company ecosystem.

Location

Remote

Availability

Part-Time (20h per week)

Must be available to collaborate during U.S. Pacific Time (PT) business hours

Compensation
Based on experience. Please indicate your desired hourly rate when submitting your application.

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge’s in-house legal team is a group of lawyers and legal professionals operating across multiple disciplines. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a practical, versatile product lawyer to join our growing legal team. The right person can identify the legal issue quickly, learn the product deeply, and give the business a practical path forward.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to product and engineering teams, embedding legal and compliance frameworks into our product lifecycle. You will own matters independently and help turn recurring questions into clear guidance and durable systems that support innovation while ensuring compliance with healthcare, privacy, and other regulatory requirements. This is a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of both AI and healthcare.

  • Flex across the broader Product, Privacy and Regulatory Legal portfolio as company priorities and risk change.

  • Coordinate with external counsel to resolve specialist issues and ensure fast delivery of actionable legal guidance and risk analysis.

  • Monitor emerging laws and regulations affecting Abridge’s products and data practices and advise internal stakeholders on their implications.

What You’ll Bring

  • Passion for Abridge’s mission and the energy and drive to support fast-moving product and operational teams

Who You Are

You're an experienced wine or beverage alcohol sales professional who understands how chain business gets done. You know how to navigate buyers, distributors, pricing, programming, and market execution, and you're comfortable taking ownership of opportunities from the initial conversation through placement and ongoing growth.

You're data-driven, highly organized, persistent, and energized by building something. You can work independently while collaborating closely with a distributed sales and marketing team.

What You Bring

  • Proven wine or beverage alcohol sales experience, with experience managing national or regional chain accounts.

You'll get a respected seat at the front of a professional practice, a clear growth path, and the trust to run your own desk — without being stuck in a "just answer the phone" rut.

What You'll Be Owning

This is a core client-facing role covering inbound phone coverage, message routing, and appointment scheduling for a practice that serves individual taxpayers and business owners year-round. You aren't just answering the phone; you're triaging every caller, telling existing clients apart from new individual filers and business prospects, and making sure the right person gets the right information the first time.

You'll take the lead on:

  • Introductory-Call Scheduling:Booking 15-minute introductory calls for prospective business clients into the correct staff member's calendar, with zero double-bookings or misrouted appointments.

  • Tax-Season Scale-Up:Coordinating ahead of January on call volume, priority clients, and messaging changes, then moving smoothly into full-time Monday–Friday coverage from January to April.

  • Smarter Workflows:Using transcription, AI-assisted drafting, and scheduling automation to keep call handling fast and precise.


Requirements

This Role Is a Great Fit If You:

  • Sound Great on the Phone:You have excellent spoken English and clear, professional phone etiquette that puts US-based callers at ease immediately.

  • Have Front-Line Experience:You have proven customer service, reception, or phone/call-center experience. Accounting or tax industry experience is not required.

  • Write Clean, Organised Messages:Your written English is strong enough that every message email is accurate and easy to act on.

  • Work Independently:You're comfortable handling your shifts with minimal real-time supervision.

  • Can Commit to the Schedule:You can reliably cover the fixed Tuesday, Wednesday, and Friday shifts and flex into full-time hours every January to April.

  • Are Trustworthy and Discreet:You handle callers' personal and financial information with care and confidentiality.

  • Are High-Accountability:You don't need to be chased for updates. You're reliable, meet deadlines, and own your mistakes as much as your wins.

  • Are Set Up for Remote Work:You have reliable high-speed internet, a quiet and professional home workspace, and basic proficiency with email, calendar/scheduling tools, and general office software.

Genuine differentiators (not requirements):Experience in accounting, tax, bookkeeping, or another professional-services environment; prior work as a virtual assistant or remote receptionist for a US-based client; familiarity with Calendly, Google Calendar, or VoIP phone systems; experience working a seasonal schedule.

What Success Looks Like

After 60–90 Days:

  • Coverage Is Rock-Solid:You reliably cover every agreed shift without gaps and correctly identify existing clients, individual prospects, and business owners on every call.

  • Messages Need Zero Follow-Up:Every message is complete, accurate, and in the right inbox within minutes, without prompting.

  • Scheduling Is Yours:You've taken over booking 15-minute introductory calls for business prospects, with no double-bookings.

  • The Team Is Freed Up:You handle the large majority of calls independently, the team member who used to cover phones is fully free of routine phone duties, and you're ready to scale into full-time hours for tax season.

  • Trust Is Earned:You're fully autonomous across phone coverage and scheduling, beginning to take on light admin tasks, and recognised as a dependable extension of the team.

Final Word

If you've ever thought:

"I love being the voice that makes people feel welcome, and I'm great at getting the details right. I just want a steady role where reliability is valued and I'm trusted to own my work instead of following a script." This is that role.

Let's build long-term success — together.

Who We Are

At Vista, we are building an industry-leading Customer Relevance Platform to scale personalization across products, design templates, and marketing messages. We are moving away from 'model sprawl' toward a unified architecture centered on fmX, a foundation model that learns shared embeddings for all relevant entities for Vista (users, products, marketing messages, templates, etc.).

Our strategic vision focuses on delivering a "Context-aware Customer Experience." To achieve this, we are prioritizing the evolution toward Intent-Based Personalization, capturing real-time journey signals, and infusing our recommendations into Agentic Experiences. This means equipping AI assistants with an Agentic Reasoning Layer that sits on top of our fmX rankers, enabling personalized recommendations to fit seamlessly into agentic workflows and user experiences.

What You Will Do

As the Principal Data Scientist, you will drive the generative, intent-based, and agentic evolution of our platform. A critical part of your role will be to act as the primary bridge between traditional data science practices (ranking, embeddings, deep learning) and advanced LLM / Agentic reasoning layers. You will partner directly with another Principal Data Scientist to co-lead our research agenda, accelerating our strategic progress and elevating the capabilities of the wider Data Science team.

  • Bridging Data Science & Agentic Experiences (Key Responsibility): Act as the primary technical bridge between core ML/DS modeling and modern LLM application layers. Translate classical recommendations, graph embeddings, and fmX outputs into robust reasoning abstractions for use in agentic workflows.

  • Agentic Reasoning & Recommendations: Lead the evolution of recommendations into the Generative AI era. Design and build the agentic reasoning layer that wraps around our fmX models and rankers. Implement patterns that allow models to self-correct, reason, and contextually explain recommendations to customers.

  • Tool-Use & MCP Architecture: Architect and build the ML pathways and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to expose core recommendation models and data as modular tools for AI agents. This allows conversational shopping experiences to dynamically query, rank, and synthesize candidates in real time.

  • Intent-Based Personalization: Develop an algorithmic intent layer that translates real-time browsing and session signals into structured, context-aware customer intents to feed directly into the fmX-based recommendation pipeline.

  • Broad Personalization & Segmentation: Build advanced propensity models and leverage behavioral traits to drive actionable, business-aligned customer segmentations and dynamic personas.

  • AI Leadership & Strategy: Act as Vista's AI ambassador, influencing product, engineering, and business leadership to adopt a model-driven, agent-first approach. Ensure models integrate cleanly with delivery systems without hurting Core Web Vitals or caching efficiency.

Your Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning models and deep learning systems into high-scale customer experiences.

  • Demonstrated experience or active thinking/experimentation in building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to bridge data/ML systems with LLM orchestrators in a production context.

  • Deep expertise in Deep Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Reinforcement Learning (especially applied to real-time feedback loops or personalized ranking).

SiFi is a fast-growing B2B FinTech company specializing in spend management and card issuance solutions. We help companies take control of their spending, streamline expense workflows, and operate with greater efficiency.

Role Overview

The IT Governance Senior Specialist sets and governs the processes that control how SiFi runs and changes its technology. As a SAMA-licensed institution operating live payment systems, every production change and every service process has to be controlled, traceable and audit-ready.

This role designs SiFi's IT governance, IT service management (ITSM) and change management processes together with the Infrastructure, Engineering and Cybersecurity teams, and makes sure they are implemented and followed. The processes must align with ITIL best practice and the SAMA IT Governance Framework, and hold up under audit and regulatory review.

1. IT Governance & Regulatory Alignment
  • Develop and maintain IT governance policies, standards and procedures aligned with ITIL 4 and the SAMA IT Governance Framework
  • Run gap and maturity assessments against SAMA requirements, and own the resulting remediation plans through to closure
  • Prepare evidence and coordinate internal audits, external audits and regulatory reviews of IT governance controls
  • Work with Cybersecurity GRC, Risk and Compliance on shared controls (SAMA Cyber Security and Business Continuity frameworks)

2. IT Service Management
  • Co-design, roll out and continuously improve ITSM processes with Infrastructure, Engineering and Cybersecurity: incident, problem, service request, service level, configuration and asset, and knowledge management
  • Define and maintain the IT service catalogue, SLAs and OLAs with Engineering, Operations and Customer Support

  • Configure process workflows in the ITSM platform and drive adoption across teams

3. Change Management
  • Design and govern the change management framework: change request standards, risk and impact classification, Change Advisory Board (CAB), standard and emergency changes, and post-implementation reviews
  • Identify and track IT risks and control gaps arising from technology changes, ensure appropriate mitigating controls and ownership are defined, and follow remediation actions through to closure.
  • Co-develop the process with Infrastructure, Engineering and Cybersecurity so it fits how each team delivers, and embed it in their tooling and workflows
  • Act as process owner, not technical approver: approval of individual changes stays with the relevant engineering, infrastructure and security leads

jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote — open to applicants worldwide.  Visa sponsorship is not available.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote — open to applicants worldwide. Visa sponsorship is not available.
Reports to: CEO
Employment type: Full-time
Schedule: 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with some flexibility, working with a globally distributed team
Openings: One; immediate start

About us

Super Organics is a multi-brand wellness and supplement company headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. We're the parent company behind a growing portfolio of trusted supplement brands—each built on a commitment to quality, transparency, and products people can feel good about.

About the role

We are hiring a Supply Chain & Operations Manager to oversee supply planning and operational execution across our growing portfolio of consumer brands. This is a hands-on role reporting directly to the CEO, with no direct reports.

You will manage the flow of products from demand planning and purchase orders through manufacturing, quality release, warehousing, and fulfillment. You will also coordinate packaging artwork, manage relationships with contract manufacturers and our third-party logistics provider, own brand-side quality and compliance decisions, and identify opportunities to reduce fulfillment and shipping costs.

The primary objective is to keep products in stock while managing inventory and working capital responsibly and maintaining product quality and compliance.

Inventory planning and purchasing

  • Monitor inventory, sales velocity, open orders, and projected stock coverage by SKU.
  • Forecast demand using sales history, seasonality, promotions, and known business needs.
  • Identify potential stockouts early and take action to prevent them.
  • Prepare and submit purchase orders with appropriate quantities and delivery dates.
  • Maintain healthy inventory levels without tying up unnecessary cash.
  • Track purchase orders from placement through production, quality release, receipt, and reconciliation.

Manufacturing and supplier management

  • Serve as the primary operational contact for contract manufacturers and key suppliers.
  • Obtain clear commitments for production schedules, quantities, pricing, and availability dates.
  • Monitor production progress and escalate delays or constraints that could affect product availability.
  • Coordinate production priorities, new product launches, reformulations, and product transitions.
  • Reconcile ordered, produced, released, and received quantities.
  • Work with Accounting to resolve invoice discrepancies and coordinate payments.

Quality and compliance

  • Own brand-side quality and compliance decisions for products made by contract manufacturers, including product release, holds, and disposition.
  • Apply familiarity with dietary supplement current good manufacturing practices (cGMP), including 21 CFR Part 111, to supplier oversight, quality records, and outsourced manufacturing responsibilities.
  • Review manufacturer quality documentation and testing against established product specifications before approving release; investigate discrepancies and coordinate corrective actions.
  • Oversee label and packaging compliance reviews, including required information, approved claims, version control, and final artwork approval, involving qualified technical or regulatory expertise as needed.
  • Maintain lot traceability, complaint records, and recall readiness; lead coordination of quality investigations, product holds, and recalls when needed.
  • Document quality decisions and ensure manufacturers, warehouses, and internal teams act on the correct product status.

Packaging and artwork

  • Coordinate packaging artwork for new products, updates, and reorders.
  • Manage timelines across internal teams, designers, printers, packaging suppliers, and manufacturers.
  • Maintain organized records of approved artwork, packaging specifications, proofs, and production files.
  • Ensure the correct approved materials are used for each production run.
  • Identify artwork or packaging issues before they delay production.

Warehousing and fulfillment

  • Manage the operating relationship with the company's third-party logistics provider.
  • Monitor receiving, inventory accuracy, fulfillment speed, damages, backorders, and shipping exceptions.
  • Reconcile warehouse receipts against purchase orders and manufacturer shipment records.
  • Resolve discrepancies involving inventory counts, product status, damaged goods, or missing receipts.
  • Establish clear service expectations and escalation procedures with logistics partners.

Shipping and cost optimization

  • Analyze fulfillment, parcel, freight, packaging, and accessorial costs across direct-to-consumer and business-to-business orders.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce shipping costs while maintaining acceptable delivery times and customer service.
  • Evaluate carrier mix, service levels, packaging dimensions, shipment consolidation, and order routing.
  • Review parcel, LTL, and other freight options for wholesale shipments.
  • Audit logistics charges and investigate recurring billing or service issues.

Systems and reporting

  • Maintain reliable records of inventory, purchase orders, production status, receipts, and remaining balances.
  • Provide clear reporting on stock coverage, at-risk SKUs, open orders, delivery commitments, and purchasing needs.
  • Distinguish confirmed commitments from estimates and assumptions.
  • Create practical processes and documentation that can scale with the business.

What success looks like

  • Products remain in stock and supply risks are identified early.
  • Purchase orders are accurate and placed with sufficient lead time.
  • Every open order has a clear status, owner, remaining quantity, and expected availability date.
  • Packaging and artwork are completed without delaying production.
  • Product release and compliance decisions are documented, with reliable lot traceability and recall readiness.
  • Manufacturer shipments, warehouse receipts, and inventory records reconcile accurately.
  • Logistics partners consistently meet service expectations.
  • Inventory and shipping costs improve through measurable operational changes.
  • Leadership has a clear view of supply risks, purchasing needs, and required decisions.

Requirements

  • At least 4 years of experience in supply chain, operations, purchasing, production planning, inventory management, logistics, or a related role.
  • Direct experience managing both contract manufacturers and third-party logistics providers (3PLs).
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate sales and inventory data into purchasing decisions.
  • Experience creating and managing purchase orders and reconciling them against receipts and invoices.
  • Familiarity with dietary supplement cGMP requirements under 21 CFR Part 111 and the quality responsibilities of a brand that outsources manufacturing, including label compliance, product release, traceability, and recall readiness.
  • Sound judgment and willingness to own quality and compliance decisions, document the basis for decisions, and involve qualified expertise when needed.
  • Strong project-management, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Comfortable working across several internal teams and external partners in a globally distributed team.
  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn inventory, ERP, accounting, and warehouse systems.
  • Availability to work 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Eastern Time, with some flexibility.

Strongly preferred: Experience in supplements. Prior experience in a regulated product category is not required.

Benefits

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Remote work with a globally distributed team
