jobs.description:
Operations Lead

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $6 to $7/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About Pillar Health Solutions ()

Pillar Health Solutions partners with medical practices to provide outsourced nutrition, dietary, exercise, and wellness support to their patients.

Our model allows physician practices to expand the services available to their patients without having to build and manage an entire wellness team internally. Pillar supports the operational infrastructure behind the program, including patient coordination, provider support, scheduling, documentation, communication, reporting, and billing-related workflows.

We are building a model that should feel simple and seamless for the physician practice, even though there are many moving parts behind the scenes.

That is where the Operations Lead comes in.

About the Role

We are looking for an Operations Lead who can build, run, and continuously improve the operational engine behind Pillar Health Solutions.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working in a growing healthcare business where processes are still evolving.

You will work closely with leadership and take ownership of the workflows connecting physician partners, practice staff, patients, dietitians, exercise professionals, and internal support teams.

You may be investigating why patients are not scheduling, improving a referral workflow, resolving a practice issue, reviewing operational data, building a new process, creating an SOP, coordinating provider capacity, or implementing automation to eliminate repetitive work.

As Pillar grows, this role should evolve from personally managing many operational processes to building the systems, team structure, accountability, and workflows that allow the company to scale efficiently.

We are looking for someone who does not simply identify problems. You should be able to determine why they are happening, create a practical solution, implement it, and measure whether the solution worked.

What You Will Own

Practice Onboarding & Client Operations

  • Own new practice onboarding from agreement through launch, including referral, scheduling, communication, documentation, and billing-related workflows.

  • Serve as a key operational point of contact for physician partners and practice staff, ensuring requests, concerns, and follow-ups are addressed promptly.

Patient Operations & Engagement

  • Oversee the patient journey from referral through outreach, scheduling, first appointment, and ongoing engagement.

  • Monitor cancellations, no-shows, scheduling delays, and patient drop-off points, then implement workflows to improve conversion and retention.

Provider & Clinical Operations

  • Coordinate operationally with dietitians, exercise professionals, and support staff to maintain appropriate availability, capacity, and coverage.

  • Monitor provider scheduling, patient assignments, operational responsiveness, and adherence to documentation expectations.

Documentation, Billing & Revenue Operations

  • Monitor the timely completion and flow of documentation and billing-related information between providers, Pillar, and partner practices.

  • Investigate operational issues that may delay billing, reimbursement, or revenue and coordinate appropriate resolution.

Systems, SOPs & Process Improvement

  • Map workflows, identify bottlenecks, duplicated work, and failure points, then redesign processes to improve speed, accuracy, and accountability.

  • Build practical SOPs, trackers, dashboards, templates, checklists, and standardized workflows for recurring operational activities.

KPI & Performance Management

  • Track core operational KPIs across referrals, scheduling, patient engagement, provider utilization, documentation, service delivery, and partner performance.

  • Analyze trends and operational gaps to determine what changed, why it changed, and what action should be taken.

  • Provide leadership with concise reporting on performance, risks, unresolved issues, priorities, and recommended next steps.

Technology & AI

  • Evaluate and implement tools that simplify operations, reduce administrative workload, and improve visibility across the business.

  • Use AI and automation to improve reporting, workflow management, analysis, documentation, communication, and recurring operational processes.

Founder & Leadership Partnership

  • Translate leadership priorities and ideas into clear operational plans, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Surface risks and unresolved issues early while bringing recommended solutions instead of only reporting problems.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare operations, medical practice operations, program management, client success, healthcare administration, or a closely related field.

  • Experience owning processes and outcomes rather than only completing assigned administrative tasks.

  • Strong understanding of patient scheduling, provider coordination, documentation, healthcare administrative workflows, and service operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational problems, investigate root causes, and independently implement solutions.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with physicians, practice staff, healthcare professionals, patients, and senior leadership.

  • Experience creating or improving SOPs, workflows, dashboards, trackers, or operational systems.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with patient information, documentation, billing information, and operational data.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, changing, or early-stage environment.

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools, systems, workflows, and processes independently.

  • Practical experience using AI, automation, or technology to improve business processes.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting US medical practices or healthcare organizations.

  • Experience in telehealth, nutrition, wellness, chronic care, preventive health, exercise programs, or virtual healthcare services.

  • Familiarity with healthcare insurance, eligibility, reimbursement, billing, claims, or revenue-cycle workflows.

  • Experience working with EHR/EMR systems, scheduling platforms, CRM tools, telehealth systems, or patient communication platforms.

  • Experience coordinating or managing remote healthcare teams.

  • Experience with physician practice onboarding, account management, or client success.

  • Experience building processes or operations within an early-stage or rapidly growing company.

  • Previous ownership of operational KPIs, service-level metrics, or business performance reporting.

The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here

You are someone who naturally asks:

What is supposed to happen? What is actually happening? Where is the gap? Why is it happening? Who owns fixing it? How do we prevent it from happening again?

You are proactive, resourceful, highly organized, and comfortable working with ambiguity.

You do not need every process to already exist before you can start working. You are comfortable creating structure where structure is missing.

You enjoy both strategy and execution. You can discuss operational priorities with leadership and then personally investigate a scheduling issue, analyze a broken workflow, create a process, or coordinate a solution.

You are comfortable taking ownership without waiting to be repeatedly reminded.

You communicate clearly, escalate thoughtfully, and understand the difference between simply reporting a problem and actually helping solve it.

Most importantly, you think in terms of systems.

When the same issue happens repeatedly, your instinct should not be to keep fixing it manually. Your instinct should be to understand why it keeps happening and build a better process.

What Success Looks Like

During your first few weeks, success will mean developing a strong understanding of Pillar's end-to-end operating model and creating clear visibility into how physician practices, patients, providers, documentation, billing, and internal workflows connect.

You will identify the biggest operational bottlenecks, improve patient and practice workflows, strengthen accountability, establish meaningful operational reporting, and reduce recurring operational issues.

Over time, you will help build an operating system capable of supporting substantially more physician practices, patients, and providers without operational complexity increasing at the same rate as the business.

The ultimate goal is simple:

Create an operation where physician practices receive a reliable experience, patients move through the program smoothly, providers have the support they need, leadership has visibility into performance, and fewer problems require manual intervention as Pillar grows.

We are a well-funded, high-velocity startup backed by TTV Capital and Tusk Venture Partners. We are obsessed with helping the next generation of tradespeople launch successful careers, and we are updating our entire stack to be AI-First.

The Role: Code at the Speed of Thought

We're hiring a Senior Engineer who is all-in on AI-native workflows. If hand-crafting every line of boilerplate PHP is a badge of honor for you, this isn't the role.

You'll treat AI agents (Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, Cursor) as your primary toolset — an orchestrator who ships comprehensive features far faster than traditional developers, architecting the automated backbone that lets trade schools scale. You'll work across multiple projects in parallel, using AI to plan, build, test, and iterate without losing sight of quality or outcomes. This is about moving the business forward: getting valuable, working software into customers' hands as fast as possible — not slowly perfecting isolated tickets.

What we're looking for

  • Outcome ownership. You own problems, not tickets — understanding the customer need, knowing why the work matters, making smart technical calls, testing what you ship, and staying accountable until it's delivering real value in the real world.

  • Product thinking. You care how customers actually use what you build. You connect technical decisions to the broader product vision and turn customer problems into simple, useful software. If understanding the "why" and shaping the user experience are among your strengths, you'll thrive here.

  • Judgment over vibes. Speed matters, but speed without judgment isn't enough. We're not looking for "vibe coders" who accept AI output and move on. Use AI to accelerate, then verify, refine, and simplify until the product does exactly what it should. The goal is useful software, not more code.

  • Open communication. We work in the open — flag risks early, ask when the "why" is unclear, and speak up when something doesn't make sense. No surprises, no silent blockers, no unnecessary complexity.

How we work:

You're joining a high-trust, high-output team — one that's greater than the sum of its parts, because people move faster and build better when they share context openly and take ownership together. We keep our egos low and take the mission seriously.

But here's the honest part: we love this work. The building, the designing, the debugging, the problem-solving — that isn't the price we pay to get somewhere. It is the fun. We enjoy it so much that it doesn’t feel like a job. So if crafting, building, and chasing down a hard bug is genuinely how you like to spend your time — if that's what you call fun — then this is the right place.

To prove you have read this tell us in your application what you'd do with a golden banana. There are no wrong answers, except not answering.

You're not just writing code. You're building the business.

The Stack & Tooling

  • Core: PHP 8.4+, Laravel 12+, Livewire, Filament

  • AI Tooling (Mandatory): You must be proficient with agentic coding tools like Claude Code, Gemini, and Codex.

  • Data & AI Infra: MySQL, Redis, and vector databases (pgvector/Pinecone) for RAG implementations to make school data accessible via natural language.

  • Testing: Pest PHP (AI writes the tests; you verify the coverage).

What We Require (No Compromises)

  • Agentic Workflow Mastery: You don’t just "use ChatGPT sometimes." AI is not your “rubbery ducky.” You have a fully developed workflow using tools like Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, etc. to generate, refactor, and debug complex codebases. You live in the AI tooling so much that you occasionally wonder why you even have an IDE installed. Your workflow should be built around orchestrating AI agents to plan, generate, refactor, test, and ship real production code quickly.

  • Laravel Expertise: You know the framework deeply enough to instantly spot when the AI is hallucinating or using an anti-pattern. You can guide the AI to use Service Providers, Facades, and Eloquent correctly.

  • Business Logic Intuition: You understand that we are building a mission-critical platform. You can translate complex school workflows into clean technical architecture.

  • Database Design & Structure: This is the heart of it — you can take a messy, real-world problem and turn it into a clean database structure. You think in schemas: modeling a complex domain into well-normalized tables, knowing exactly when to denormalize for speed, and designing indexes that keep queries fast as tables grow into the millions of rows. You spot an N+1, a missing index, or a migration that'll lock a production table before it ships

  • Shipping Mindset: You value outcomes over output. You care about the feature landing in the school administrator's hands, not the purity of the implementation process.

  • 5+ Years Experience: In shipping production web applications (SaaS preferred).

Why Join Lumion Now?

  • The Impact:
    Building the American Dream, One Graduate at a Time

    America is short millions of skilled workers — electricians, plumbers, nurses, technicians — the people who keep the country running. The demand is there. The students are there. What's missing is schools that can move someone from enrolled, to graduated, to hired without drowning in operational friction.

    That's the bottleneck we're removing. We're building the AI-first operating system for these institutions, and every bit of friction you engineer away is a real person who makes it to the finish line — a single parent who finally has a career instead of a paycheck-to-paycheck job, the first in their family to graduate into a real trade, someone going from "unemployed" to a future they can actually build a life on.

    You won't be shipping features into a void. You'll be helping millions of people reach the American dream — a stable, meaningful career that changes the trajectory of their whole family. The impact is direct, it's human, and it's exactly why we do this

  • AI Sandbox: We encourage you to experiment with the newest models and tools. If a new agentic tool comes out that saves time, we buy it.

  • Remote-First Culture: We don't care where you sit, as long as you are authorized to work in the US and are aligned with our timezone for collaboration.

  • We're Well-Funded — and Just Getting Started

    This isn't a "hope it works out" gamble. We closed a $10.7M seed round backed by leading fintech and venture investors who believe in what we're building. And the traction backs it up. Lumion is now the operating system for 400+ career schools, supporting 150,000+ students across 48 states and 29 industries. The results speak for themselves — schools on Lumion see 47% more completed applications, a 73.6% application-to-enrollment rate, 91% on-time tuition collection, and 21% higher student retention. We've got the capital, the momentum, and the market timing — enrollment in the trades is finally outpacing four-year colleges — to build something that lasts. You'd be joining early enough to shape the product and the company, with the runway to actually do it right.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary: $110,000 - $130,000 USD

  • Equity: Meaningful stock options in a venture-backed startup.

  • Bonuses: Quarterly performance-based cash bonuses.

  • Perks: Unlimited PTO, 401(k), full Health/Dental/Vision reimbursement up to $537.50/mo, $200/mo tech stipend, $100/mo wellness stipend.

Join Lumion. Build the OS for the future of skilled trades. 🚀

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

The United States Based Salary range for this role is: 140,000-200,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

Один із регіонів, який ми активно розвиваємо та де вже маємо сильну команду — це Балкани. На тебе чекають такі задачі:

  • Продаж підписок на розміщення вакансій клієнтам, які зареєструвалися на сайті

  • Проведення вихідних дзвінків, листування в e-mail та Viber для доведення клієнтів до угоди

  • Проведення переговорів, консультацій, презентацій та підготовка пропозицій

  • Визначення потреб клієнтів та обмін зібраними даними з командою для вдосконалення продукту

  • Фіксування всіх етапів переговорів, угод та статусів клієнтів у CRM-системі

  • Виконання щомісячного плану продажів (KPI)

  • Взаємодія у Slack з фінансовим відділом щодо інвойсів, саппортом та модерацією.

Необхідні навички та досвід:

  • Досвід роботи у продажах від 1 року

  • Вільне володіння сербською мовою (для комунікації з клієнтами), а також англійською на середньому та вище рівні (для внутрішнього спілкування з командою та керівником команди)

  • Повністю дистанційний формат роботи (фріланс формат)

  • Реальний вплив на продукт: ваша думка та ідеї мають значення

  • 16 днів оплачуваної відпустки на рік + вихідні усі сербські державні свята

Якщо ця роль тобі відгукується — надсилай резюме, і ми зв’яжемося з тобою найближчим часом.

jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Refer them!

jobs.title: Principal Brand Designer
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleAt OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities.
jobs.description:
About the Role

At OLX, Design is more than aesthetics, it's how millions of people build trust, discover opportunities, and connect with their communities. As Principal Brand Designer, you'll shape how OLX and its portfolio of brands are experienced across every customer touchpoint.

Reporting to the Director of Product Design, you'll define the visual principles, creative systems, and brand standards that unite a diverse portfolio while allowing each brand to express its unique identity. This is a highly strategic, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines exceptional craft with systems thinking, influences through expertise, and embraces AI as a catalyst for creativity, consistency, and scale.

Working in close partnership with Marketing, Brand Strategy, Product Design, Communications, Employer Brand and regional teams, you'll translate business strategy, customer insights and brand positioning into cohesive creative systems that strengthen brand equity, build customer trust and accelerate high-quality execution across the organisation.

You'll establish the creative vision and quality bar for brand design, while building the frameworks, governance and tools that enable teams worldwide to create distinctive, consistent and impactful brand experiences.

What you'll own

    Define the future of OLX’s Group's brand ecosystem

    Partnering with the Director of Product Design, Marketing and Brand Strategy, you'll evolve the visual identity and creative direction across OLX Group and its portfolio of brands. You'll ensure our brands feel connected where they should, distinctive where they need to be, and consistently recognisable across every customer touchpoint.

  • Group-wide brand identity systems and visual standards

  • Brand visual identity governance, quality assurance and design principles

  • Multi-brand design systems and asset libraries

  • Creative direction across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints related to brand design (excludes advertising)

  • Long-term evolution of OLX Group's visual identity and assets.

    • Build scalable creative systems powered by AI

    You'll help define how AI enhances brand design across OLX Group by developing AI-ready design systems, prompt libraries, reusable templates, automation workflows and governance that empower teams to produce high-quality work consistently and efficiently.

    Rather than replacing creativity, you'll ensure AI amplifies craftsmanship, accelerates production and strengthens consistency while maintaining the integrity of every brand.

    You'll also stay ahead of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities where AI can improve creative workflows, collaboration and design quality across the organisation.

    Raise the creative standard across OLX Group

    As the most senior brand design practitioner, you'll establish the benchmark for the application of brand design across product launches, executive communications, presentations, employer branding, events, web experiences and marketing initiatives.

    You'll provide creative direction, thoughtful critique and hands-on design leadership, ensuring every expression of the brand reflects exceptional craft, clarity and purpose.

    Translate strategy into brand experiences

    You'll partner closely with Marketing and Brand Strategy from the earliest stages of initiatives, transforming customer insights, research and business priorities into compelling visual systems and brand experiences.

    You'll contribute strategic thinking—not simply execute briefs, helping teams solve complex business challenges through design that strengthens trust, recognition and long-term brand value.

    Drive adoption and influence across the organisation

    Creating great systems is only part of the role, you'll ensure they're embraced.

    You'll build documentation, enablement programmes, design resources and governance models that help global and regional teams confidently apply OLX Group's brand standards.

    You'll influence senior stakeholders across Product, Marketing and Executive Leadership, aligning teams around a shared creative vision and ensuring design has a meaningful voice in strategic decision-making.

    Mentor and elevate the craft

    As a Principal Designer, your influence extends well beyond your own work.

    You'll coach designers through critique, mentoring and collaboration, fostering a culture of craftsmanship, systems thinking and continuous improvement. While this isn't a people management role, you'll be recognised as a trusted design leader whose expertise elevates the entire organisation.

What we're looking for

    We're looking for a strategic design leader with exceptional craft, systems thinking and a passion for building brands that scale globally.

    You create brands that people trust

    Your portfolio demonstrates outstanding work across visual identity, typography, layout, storytelling, motion and digital experiences. You understand how to create memorable brands—and how to evolve and steward them over time.

    You think in systems

    You build frameworks, governance models, templates and design systems that enable organisations to produce consistently exceptional work. You know that the best design creates lasting capability, not just individual deliverables.

    You bring strategy to life through Design

    You're comfortable partnering with Marketing, Brand Strategy and executive stakeholders, translating positioning, customer insights and business objectives into creative systems that deliver measurable business impact.

    You're fluent in AI-enabled Design

    You already incorporate AI into your creative practice and understand where emerging technologies create value, and where human judgement remains essential.
    You can translate those insights into scalable workflows that improve quality, speed, experimentation and consistency across teams.

    You influence without authority

    You communicate with clarity, build trusted relationships and bring people together around a shared creative vision. You're equally comfortable presenting to executives, collaborating with marketers or mentoring fellow designers.

    You bring depth of experience

    You'll likely have:

  • 10+ years of experience in brand design, or visual design

  • Experience building or evolving brands at scale across multiple products or markets

  • Expertise in Figma and/or Adobe Creative Suite

  • Experience with motion design, storytelling, and digital brand experiences

  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems

  • Deep familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and workflows

  • Outstanding communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills

Why join OLX

    OLX operates some of the world's most recognized online marketplaces, connecting millions of people every day to buy, sell, find jobs, discover homes, and build businesses.

    As our Principal Brand Designer, you'll have a unique opportunity to shape the future of multiple global brands while defining how AI and design systems work together to create consistent, high-quality brand experiences at scale.

    This role offers the chance to influence design beyond individual projects to build the frameworks, standards, and creative vision that will guide OLX's brands for years to come.

    If you're excited by solving complex brand challenges, setting the highest creative standards, and pioneering the future of AI-enabled design, we'd love to hear from you.

Hiring Process

    We believe in a transparent and collaborative hiring process that reflects how we work as a team. Here’s what you can expect:
    First Stage
    Portfolio & Design Leadership
    This is a 90-minute session with the Hiring Manager. We’ll dive deep into your portfolio to assess your design craft, strategic thinking, systems mindset, and collaboration skills. This is also an opportunity to showcase your leadership in design and discuss how you approach complex challenges.

    Second Stage
    Multi-Brand Systems & Creative Leadership
    In this 60-minute session, you’ll meet with a senior leader from the Creative team. We’ll explore your ability to build, evolve, and govern brand systems across a complex multi-brand organization. This stage focuses on your creative leadership and how you ensure consistency and innovation across diverse brands.

    Third Stage
    Executive Partnership & Business Impact
    This 45-minute session is with a senior leader from the Marketing team. We’ll assess your leadership presence, ability to form strategic partnerships with Marketing, and your commercial thinking. This is also a chance to discuss how you drive organizational influence and deliver business impact through brand design.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

Data Process Policy

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement.

Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.***


The Senior Site Reliability Engineer - Data Platforms will improve the reliability, observability, and operational maturity of cloud-based data platforms and production data pipelines. This SRE-first role focuses on production reliability and operational ownership, with primary data-pipeline development and core infrastructure engineering handled in partnership with the respective engineering teams. You will work closely with Data Engineering, Cloud, Platform, Application, Security, and FinOps teams to improve production health, incident response, automation, observability, resilience, and operational efficiency.


What you will do:

  • Own and improve the reliability, availability, performance, and operational health of production data platforms and pipelines.
  • Monitor and support pipeline execution, dependencies, failures, delays, recovery, and downstream impact.
  • Troubleshoot complex production issues across AWS, data platforms, pipelines, and supporting services.
  • Design and improve observability using enterprise platforms such as Datadog and Splunk, including dashboards, alerting, logging, and service-health indicators.
  • Improve signal quality, reduce alert noise, and strengthen incident detection and diagnosis.
  • Lead or participate in production incident response, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Use Python to automate operational tasks, monitoring, health checks, remediation, and repetitive support activities.
  • Apply SRE practices including service-level objectives, incident management, operational readiness, capacity planning, resilience, disaster recovery, and reduction of operational toil.
  • Use SQL for production troubleshooting, validation, and investigation.
  • Understand and troubleshoot infrastructure managed through Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, partnering with Cloud or Platform Engineering when deeper infrastructure changes are required.
  • Identify recurring operational issues and drive sustainable engineering improvements.
  • Contribute to performance, capacity, and cost-efficiency improvements across AWS and data-platform services.
  • Develop and improve operational runbooks and recovery procedures.
  • Participate in the PagerDuty on-call rotation, including occasional weekend coverage.
  • Understand how the platform and its pipelines behave in production, recognize emerging reliability risks, diagnose issues quickly, restore service effectively, and implement lasting improvements.
  • Use observability and automation to move operations from reactive support toward proactive reliability engineering, reducing recurring incidents and manual operational effort while improving the overall resilience of the data platform.

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of hands-on AWS experience supporting production environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Production Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Reliability Engineering.
  • Strong practical understanding and implementation of SRE principles and production operations.
  • Experience supporting Amazon Redshift or similar enterprise data platforms in production.
  • Experience owning or supporting the reliability and operations of production data pipelines or data-intensive services.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise observability platforms such as Datadog and Splunk.
  • Strong Python programming skills for automation and operational tooling.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for production investigation and troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, with the ability to read, review, and troubleshoot existing IaC.
  • Experience with incident management, root-cause analysis, and implementing preventive and corrective actions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex production environments.

What will set you apart:

  • Hands-on production experience with Snowflake.
  • Experience supporting multiple cloud-based data platforms.
  • Experience designing observability for large-scale, distributed, or data-intensive systems.
  • Experience with AIOps, intelligent automation, or agentic operations applied to production operations.
  • Experience using AI-assisted approaches for incident detection, diagnosis, alert enrichment, runbook execution, operational automation, or guarded remediation.
  • Familiarity with AWS-native monitoring services such as Amazon CloudWatch.
  • Experience with data-pipeline orchestration, dependency management, failure recovery, and production support.
  • Experience improving cloud-resource utilization and cost visibility.
  • Experience helping establish or mature SRE practices within an engineering organization.

This job operates in a professional office environment.

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications of the job. The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. You will be evaluated in part based on your performance of the responsibilities and/or tasks listed in this job description. You may be required to perform other duties that are not included on this job description. The job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason, as per terms and conditions of your employment contract.

What we offer you

We offer an array of diverse and inclusive benefits regardless of where you are in your career. We believe that providing our employees with the means to lead healthy balanced lives results in the best possible work performance.

  • Medical, dental, vision and life insurance
  • Retirement savings – 401(k) plan with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%), financial advisory services, potential company discretionary contribution, and a broad investment lineup
  • Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year
  • Business-casual environment that includes the option to wear jeans

  • Business Resource Groups (BRGs) – BRGs facilitate inclusion and collaboration across our business internally and throughout the communities where we live, work and play. BRGs are open to all.

Base Salary Range

$105,700.00 - $149,275.00

Equal opportunity employer • Drug-free workplace

jobs.excerpt: Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed.
jobs.description:
Taxwell helps everyday Americans get every tax advantage they deserve by finding credits and deductions they never even knew existed. Our tax preparation software offers easy guidance and ensures your maximum tax refund. We strive to build a team of like-minded experts in both tax and technology who align with our brand purpose, are advocates for our customers and have a fresh, non-traditional approach to the tax industry.

Taxwell is a leading digital tax filing platform formed in 2022 from the combination of Drake Software® and TaxAct®. These two longstanding organizations offer customers professional and do-it-yourself digital and downloadable products that are easy-to-use, best-in-class technology, and provide unparalleled customer support. Taxwell brands are a trusted solution for all users including those with complex tax returns. We strive to attract and retain candidates who exemplify our values: performance, perseverance, progress and partnership. Taxwell is an organization of forward thinkers looking to add industry experts to our growing team.


Position Summary

TaxWell is hiring a Software Engineering Manager for the Data Import team. This team builds the systems that help TaxAct, Drake Software, and Taxwell users import tax documents and related financial data into the tax-preparation experience — document upload, OCR and extraction workflows, document classification, import state tracking, partner and financial-institution integrations, and the operational diagnostics that keep production import pipelines healthy.


This is a player-coach leadership role on a cloud-backed, event-driven platform. You will lead and develop a team of software engineers (employees and contractors) building business-critical services in modern C#/.NET on AWS, own the team's delivery outcomes, and be technical enough to earn credibility in architecture, code review, and production debugging.


What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of software engineers: hiring, onboarding, performance, professional development, and career growth.
  • Own the team's delivery: planning, prioritization, work assignments, resource planning, commitments to Product, and follow-through to production.
  • Own onboarding speed and engineer productivity as explicit outcomes. You build the scaffolding that makes fast ramp normal — not the exception: scoped first tasks sized for early merges, review and pairing support, progressive exposure to production debugging, and the judgment to notice and act when a new engineer isn't ramping.
  • Provide technical direction across services and systems: guide design and architecture for document-processing pipelines (ingestion, OCR, classification, extraction, state, delivery), balancing product velocity against security, compliance, and reliability requirements.
  • Run and continuously improve the team's engineering practices: CI/CD and release management on a frequent release cadence, automated testing (unit, integration, end-to-end), observability, production incident response, and blameless post-incident learning.
  • Support adoption of AI-assisted and agentic engineering tools across the team, with clear standards for reviewing AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability. The engineer remains accountable for all output.
  • Coordinate with platform and security teams when centrally-driven infrastructure, hardening, or compliance work lands on the team's services, so it strengthens the product rather than crowding it out.
  • Troubleshoot complex, cross-service production issues alongside your engineers: application code, queues, object storage, state records, configuration, logs, and external dependencies.
  • Communicate clearly and honestly with Product and business stakeholders: tradeoffs, risks, estimates, delivery status, and operational health.

What You'll Need


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a minimum of 2 years leading or managing software engineers who shipped production software.
  • Strong hands-on background in C#/.NET and backend product engineering: APIs, event-driven and asynchronous processing, and cloud-service integration.
  • Working knowledge of cloud-native architectures, preferably AWS serverless (Lambda, SQS, S3, DynamoDB or close equivalents); Azure experience is a reasonable substitute if fundamentals are strong.
  • Experience owning or jointly owning production support for business-critical services: triage, impact assessment, rollback thinking, and escalation judgment.
  • Demonstrated ability to hire, onboard, and ramp engineers quickly, with concrete examples of engineers who became productive under your leadership.
  • Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and problem-solving skills, with the judgment to know when to fix, escalate, delegate, or hold the line.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing teams that built document processing, OCR, classification, extraction, data-ingestion, or other event-driven data pipeline systems.
  • Experience in tax, financial services, accounting, payments, or other regulated domains handling sensitive customer data.
  • Experience managing mixed employee/contractor and distributed or nearshore teams, with clear productivity accountability for each.
  • Experience with Kubernetes-based deployment, observability tooling (Splunk, Datadog, or CloudWatch), and structured logging/metrics practices.
  • Hands-on experience governing AI-assisted engineering tools (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor) on an engineering team — raising the bar, not just permitting the tools.

About the Team's Culture This team values pragmatic product engineering: production safety, careful discovery before changing unfamiliar flows, clear diagnostics and documentation, blameless production learning, useful collaboration with support/product/QA/platform partners, and thoughtful use of AI and automation


At Taxwell, we believe our work benefits from the diverse perspectives of our employees. As such, Taxwell welcomes and celebrates diversity and inclusion and is committed to equal opportunity employment. At Taxwell, you can expect a supportive, open, and inclusive atmosphere and a team that values your contributions.

Taxwell is committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and any other status protected under applicable law. The Benefits

At Stratpoint, we enjoy the autonomy, lack of bureaucracy, and the freedom to experiment but without the chaos. We’re like a startup but with adult supervision.

You will be supported by capable management of HR, Finance and IT that adheres to the highest standards of integrity and good governance.

  • a monthly miscellaneous allowance
  • 13th month pay based on your monthly rate.
  • Vacation and Sick leave
  • Wellness programs such as Wellness Wednesdays
  • HMO coverage
  • Team buildings and quarterly events (company outings and festive celebrations for Chinese New Year, Valentines, Halloween and Christmas)
  • And, friendly intramural competitions

Your Team

The candidate will report to the Service Delivery Manager and Head of Architecture Governance, collaborating with Technical Leads to address skill gaps and support needs. They will work with customers, vendors, and onshore teams to meet project success criteria and engage with technology partners like AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own technical delivery across managed services engagements — providing technical direction, assessing risk in proposed approaches, and balancing technical soundness with business/management priorities.
  • Lead solution design and architecture — contributing to trade-off analysis, Architecture Decision Records, and delivery documentation (solution docs, estimations, timelines, diagrams), with senior mentorship as needed.
  • Bridge presales to delivery — ensuring the solution scoped during presales carries through cleanly into implementation, and providing technical input into proposals, cost estimates, and client negotiations.
  • Own day-to-day Operations, Maintenance & Support delivery — incident, problem, and change management across client environments, ensuring SLAs are met and operational/architectural risk stays visible and managed.
  • Lead and quality-control distributed technical teams (L2/L3 engineers and SMEs), including mentoring, coaching, and technical people development — without requiring direct line-management authority over everyone involved.
  • Maintain multi-cloud technical currency — tracking tooling, practices, and platform developments (a working "technology radar") to guide project teams on design, troubleshooting, and modernization decisions.
  • Champion technical standards and continuous improvement — maintaining coding/technical compliance across projects and evaluating new tools, processes, and approaches.

jobs.excerpt: RemoteThe mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
jobs.description:
Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.

This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own — that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

What You'll Do

  • Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team — from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight
  • Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval
  • Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself
  • Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through
  • Keep the shared pieces in working order — tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear
  • Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own
  • Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out
  • When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time
  • Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out
  • Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear
  • Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless
  • Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early
  • Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team
  • Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team or owning a major surface while staying hands-on
  • Rock solid Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android animations, Jetpack Navigation, and JUnit tests
  • Experience shipping and maintaining background audio or other long-running background work
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing them, including what can't be covered by them
  • Something you introduced to a team that stuck after you stopped pushing it, and an honest account of what it cost to get there
  • Some comfort with the unpopular half of the job: asking people to change how they work, and living with the friction that follows
  • A view on which changes need heavy review and which don't, argued from what the system does
  • A track record of building things the rest of your team actually used, not only things that made you faster
  • The ability to describe how your team works with AI agents, not only how you do personally
  • Product design intuition, user empathy, and the drive to push Android UI/UX further than the spec asks for
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Excellent communication skills

Bonus

  • Building, maintaining, or contributing to open source Android projects
  • Experience with iOS, Web, or NodeJS

Technologies we use

  • Kotlin · Kotlin Coroutines · Kotlin Flow · Jetpack Navigation · Dagger 2 · Room · Custom Views, Canvas & Paint · Jetpack Compose · JUnit

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus an assessment on a real codebase. We aim to complete the process within 1 week.

Use the tools you use every day. A good part of the process is a walkthrough where you talk through your reasoning — why this approach, what you considered and dropped, where you were unsure.

The Portugal Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-65,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don’t forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

The Veeva Data Cloud Sales team is looking for a skilled account partner to drive sales of our modern data platform to Medtech companies. As an Account Partner, you will be responsible for aligning customer objectives to understand patients, providers and market dynamics at each stage of the brand lifecycle with the Veeva Data Cloud solutions.

This is an exciting and uniquely focused role at Veeva that requires the right blend of experience selling data solutions to Medtech with a desire to accelerate a new business line within an established industry leader. To be successful in this role, initiative, persistence and the ability to work effectively within a growing team are critical. You also possess a collaborative work style evidenced by putting the success of the team ahead of your own. You are humble, hungry, and smart with a relentless drive to do what it takes to succeed. You are solution oriented to overcome obstacles and solve business problems. This is a remote position.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop a thorough understanding of Veeva Data Cloud offerings and competitive advantages and learn to articulate them persuasively to prospects and customers

  • Align with peer team members for an organized and customer focused account strategy

  • Manage pipeline with CRM tools for maximum efficiency and visibility, with carefully executed follow-up to closure
  • Work in close partnership with Customer Success to manage successful client deployments and to ensure ongoing high client satisfaction, renewal, and deep penetration of customer organizations for incremental business
  • Keep current with industry trends; engage your customers, address their business challenges, and propose solutions

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in selling data-driven solutions to Medtech customers
  • Proven track record of exceeding sales goals while contributing to the success of the team
  • Strong understanding of Medtech use cases supported by data with a demonstrated ability to navigate the relevant ecosystem
  • 5+ years of experience in account management, business development, or consulting to life science customers
  • Eagerness to work in a startup team environment that will be rapidly changing
  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed to spend time onsite with the Customers – travel will vary depending on the candidate’s location

    3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance

jobs.excerpt: About Virtual InternshipsWe're on an ambitious and challenging mission to provide guaranteed internships to anyone, anytime, anywhere - no one else is doing this at our scale!
jobs.description:
About Virtual Internships

We're on an ambitious and challenging mission to provide guaranteed internships to anyone, anytime, anywhere - no one else is doing this at our scale! Regardless of background, major, location, or career field, every student can gain invaluable experience at innovative companies worldwide, significantly enhancing their employability and career readiness. Trusted by universities, governments, foundations, and online education institutions, we’re transforming learners' lives globally.

Our growth and impact have been recognized globally:

  • $14.3million Series A fundraise announced in September 2022, with investors including Hambro Perks, Sequoia India & Surge, Arsenal Growth, Kaplan, and Ascend Vietnam Ventures

  • Ranked 20th out of 13,000 organizations to “Escape To in 2023”Featured as a Top 100 EdTech Startup by HolonIQ in 2021, 2022, and 2023

  • Rated as a Top 50 Rising Startup by Tech in Asia in 2022

  • Remote-first with 100+ employees across 20+ countries globally

  • B2B EdTech product, trusted by 100+ universities, 10,000+ interns, and 14,000+ companies

We believe candidates should have a clear view of how we work before deciding to apply. Explore ourVI-P Guideto learn more about our values, how we operate, how we design our packages, and what it’s like to work at Virtual Internships.

Your Role

This is a frontline support internship. You'll spend most of your time on calls and in the help desk, helping interns from around the world get the most out of their Virtual Internships placement.

Virtual Internships places students and graduates into remote internships with host companies across the globe.

Our Placement Success Advisor (PSA) team supports those interns while they're on the job: checking in, solving problems, and stepping in when something isn't working.

As a Placement Support Intern, you'll join that team. If you enjoy talking to people, like being the person who sorts things out, and want to learn how a global operations team really works, this role is for you.

To be upfront: this is not a strategy or project role from day one. Project work comes later, once you're confident in the core role. In a typical week you might calm a nervous intern in their first week, untangle a scheduling mix-up between an intern and their supervisor, and spot early signs that an internship is going off track.

This is a 3-month, unpaid internship focused on providing you with hands-on experience in a process-driven role focused on reliability, organisation, and attention to detail. You will work within clearly defined systems and procedures, with support and training provided throughout the internship.

What You'll Be Doing

The role is expected to be 25 - 30 hours per week, with availability to attend required sync meetings.You'll start supported and build up to working independently. Once you're confident in the core role, you can take on operational project work.

  • Week 1: Learn. Shadow calls, learn our tools, and handle simple tickets with review.

  • Weeks 2-3: Co-lead. Run calls with a PSA alongside you and manage tickets with spot checks.

  • Weeks 4 +: Own. Run your PSAs' calls and some tickets, with a weekly check-in with your manager.

  • From around week 5: Grow. If the core role is going well, you'll take on project work such as improving our processes, frameworks, and team guides.

Project work is earned, not guaranteed. It's added on top of the core role, not instead of it.

Who We're Looking For

We care more about how you communicate and follow through than about your degree or past job titles.

You'll fit well if you:

  • Speak and write clear, natural English, and adjust your tone to whoever you're talking to

  • Stay warm and calm when someone is confused, stressed, or frustrated

  • Genuinely enjoy talking to people, including on repetitive, everyday calls

  • Do what you say you'll do, and tell someone early when you can't

  • Are comfortable learning new tools and working remotely with a global team

It's a bonus if you have:

  • Experience in customer service, student support, tutoring, peer mentoring, or a similar people-facing role

  • Experience working or studying across cultures or time zones

This probably isn't the role for you if you're mainly looking for strategy, research, or project work. We'd rather you know that now.

What You'll Gain

Real Operational Experience

You will contribute to live internship operations supporting interns and host companies globally.

Professional Systems Exposure

Gain hands-on experience using operational and customer success tools used across global organisations.

Structured Development

Receive regular feedback, defined expectations, and clear workflow training throughout the internship.

Professional Reference

Successful completion of the internship will include a professional reference supported by documented performance and contribution.

Equality & Diversity

Virtual Internships is an equal opportunity employer, committed to equality and diversity amongst both our employees and prospective applicants. We ensure all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process.

Overview

Planned Systems International is seeking a Provider Network Support Specialist to help strengthen provider network access, capacity, enrollment, credentialing, compliance, and operational performance for a federal healthcare program. This role will analyze provider network data, identify coverage and capacity gaps, support provider enrollment and recruitment activities, assist with network-related case escalations, and develop reports and recommendations for program leadership. The ideal candidate is analytical, collaborative, detail-oriented, and comfortable coordinating with clinical, operational, and contractor stakeholders.

On July 1, 2011, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH), WTC Health Program was established as a federal health care program to provide medical monitoring and treatment for eligible members in accordance with the James Zadroga 9/11 Health and Compensation Act of 2010. On December 18, 2015, President Obama signed the James Zadroga 9/11 Health and Compensation Reauthorization Act which reauthorized the WTC Health Program for 75 years, ending in 2090.

Essential Functions and Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze provider rosters and network data to identify gaps in specialty coverage, geographic access, appointment capacity, and credentialing status.
  • Coordinate with network and clinical stakeholders to validate data and track remediation activities.
  • Develop and maintain provider capacity analyses, enrollment dashboards, status reports, and leadership briefing materials.
  • Review provider enrollment and credentialing workflows, metrics, delays, and compliance concerns and recommend practical improvements.
  • Support provider recruitment, communications, training, and credentialing prioritization activities.
  • Provide consultative support for network-related escalations and help identify qualified providers for member care needs.
  • Support single case agreements and letters of agreement through established review and approval processes.
  • Conduct quality reviews and audits of provider files and network processes, document findings, and track corrective actions.
  • Develop or update SOPs, process maps, training materials, templates, and other knowledge-management resources.
  • Participate in program meetings, document decisions and action items, and coordinate follow-up with responsible stakeholders.
  • Safeguard member, provider, and program information in accordance with applicable privacy, security, and records-management requirements.

Minimum Requirements

  • Experience supporting provider network operations, provider enrollment, credentialing, healthcare operations, managed care, or a related function.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze operational data, identify gaps or trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Experience developing dashboards, reports, process documentation, or briefing materials.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage recurring deliverables, maintain accurate documentation, and track issues through resolution.
  • Ability to handle sensitive healthcare and provider information appropriately.

Additional Information

  • MS Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook)
  • Communication tools (Teams, SharePoint)

Company Benefits

PSI offers full-time, benefits eligible employees a competitive total compensation package that includes paid leave, and options for employer sponsored group medical, dental, vision, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, AD&D coverage, legal services, identity theft, and accident insurance. Flexible spending account and health saving account options offer pre-tax savings for qualified medical, dental, and vision expenses. The company sponsored 401(k) retirement plan has an employer contribution match that is immediately vested. We invest in the professional growth of our employees through professional courses, certifications, and tuition reimbursement programs.

EEO Commitment

It is company policy to promote equal employment opportunities. All personnel decisions, including, but not limited to, recruiting, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination, are made without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, citizenship status, veteran status, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
